2: foreign affairs 外交部；have an affair with 緋聞

examples.en: She never speaks ill of anyone in their absence.
examples.zh: 她從不趁人不在時說別人的壞話。

examples.en: Three members of the class were absent today.
examples.zh: 今天該班有三人缺席。

examples.en: He has accepted our invitation.
examples.zh: 他已經接受了我們的邀請。

examples.en: He died in an automobile accident years ago.
examples.zh: 他數年前死於車禍。

words.gloss: n. 帳戶；帳目(複數)；描述 / v. 解釋

examples.en: There were only 500 dollars in his bank account.
examples.zh: 他戶頭裡只有 500 元。

examples.en: The accounts show we have spent more than we received.
examples.zh: 帳目顯示我們已經入不敷出了。

examples.en: He was too shocked to give a clear account of what had happened.
examples.zh: 他驚嚇過度，無法清楚描述事情發生的經過。

examples.en: The policeman accounted for the traffic accident in detail.
examples.zh: 警察詳細說明了交通事故的經過。

examples.en: Mrs. Brown is over 80 and not very active now.
examples.zh: 布朗太太已八十多歲，現在不大活動了。

examples.en: He enjoys outdoor activities such as hiking or rock climbing.
examples.zh: 他喜歡戶外活動，例如登山或是攀岩。

examples.en: The actual number of people killed is not yet known.
examples.zh: 確實的死亡人數還不知道。

examples.en: The addition of fruit makes the cereal taste good.
examples.zh: 加了水果使穀類食品變得可口。

examples.en: Let me give you a word of advice!
examples.zh: 我給你個建議吧！

examples.en: I followed my father's advice and sold the car.
examples.zh: 我接受我父親的忠告把車賣了。

words.gloss: v. 推進；促進 / n. 前進；進步

examples.en: The president has done his utmost to advance the national interest.
examples.zh: 總統已盡了最大努力來增進國家的利益。

examples.en: What's your home address?
examples.zh: 你家的地址是什麼？

examples.en: He admitted his mistake.
examples.zh: 他承認錯誤。

examples.en: Only ticket-holders will be admitted into the theater.
examples.zh: 持票者才被允許進入戲院。

examples.en: He'd spent all his adult life in the army.
examples.zh: 他的成年生活全是在軍隊裡度過的。

examples.en: How are your affairs going?
examples.zh: 你的情況怎麼樣？

examples.en: The amount of rain affects the growth of crops.
examples.zh: 雨量影響作物的生長。

examples.en: The fight against SARS has been going on for two months.
examples.zh: 抑制 SARS 的抗鬥已展開兩個月了。

examples.en: The hills ahead are not wooded.
examples.zh: 前面的山上沒有生長樹木。

words.gloss: v. 幫助 / n. 有助之物

examples.en: She made no effort to aid Sophia.
examples.zh: 她根本不去幫助蘇菲亞。

words.gloss: v. 瞄準 / n. 目標

examples.en: He aimed the gun at the door.
examples.zh: 他把槍對準那扇門。

examples.en: The airline ordered 15 new aircraft.
examples.zh: 那家航空公司訂購了十五架新飛機。

words.gloss: v. 向…報警；使驚慌 / n. 警報；驚慌

examples.en: The fire alarmed the whole neighborhood.
examples.zh: 火災使整個街坊鄰居都驚恐起來。

examples.en: The doorkeeper sounded the alarm as soon as he saw the smoke.
examples.zh: 守門人一看見冒煙就發出警報。

examples.en: This album is full of snapshots of Dick and Jack.
examples.zh: 這相簿全是迪克和傑克的快照。

examples.en: The twins look very much alike.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎看上去非常相像。

examples.en: The injured man is unconscious but still alive.
examples.zh: 傷者不省人事但仍活著。

examples.en: She watches TV when she is alone.
examples.zh: 獨自一人時，她便看電視。

examples.en: We read books aloud a lot in our family.
examples.zh: 我們的家人常大聲朗讀書。

examples.en: I am altogether on your side in this matter.
examples.zh: 在這個問題上我完全支持你。

examples.en: Tom has always been popular among his classmates.
examples.zh: 湯姆在同學中一直很受歡迎。

words.gloss: n. 量；總額 / v. 總計

examples.en: What is the amount we owe them?
examples.zh: 我們總共欠他們多少錢？

examples.en: We were impressed by the ruins of an ancient building.
examples.zh: 我們對一處古建築廢墟印象頗深。

examples.en: Tom shouted in anger.
examples.zh: 湯姆氣憤地叫喊著。

examples.en: These novels mirror life in today's Japan from various angles.
examples.zh: 這些小說從不同角度反映了當代日本的生活。

examples.en: He sprained his ankle in the basketball game.
examples.zh: 他在籃球賽扭傷腳踝。

examples.en: Come over anytime you feel like it.
examples.zh: 你無論什麼時候想來都行。

examples.en: It may rain, but we shall go anyway.
examples.zh: 也許會下雨，可我們無論如何要去。

words.gloss: adv. 無論何處；任何地方

examples.en: Did you go anywhere/anyplace last night?
examples.zh: 你昨天夜裡有沒有到什麼地方去？

examples.en: Apes are the animals I like the best.
examples.zh: 大猩猩是我最喜歡的動物。

examples.en: John's appearance in the doorway was welcomed with shouts.
examples.zh: 約翰出現在門口時，大家高喊著歡迎他。

examples.en: Exercise gave her a good appetite.
examples.zh: 運動使她胃口大增。

examples.en: He has applied for a post in English.
examples.zh: 他已申請在英國任職。

examples.en: You'd better apply some ointment to the cut.
examples.zh: 你最好在傷口上塗些藥膏。

examples.en: Her talent for music was not appreciated.
examples.zh: 她的音樂才能無人賞識。

examples.en: I really appreciate all the help you gave me.
examples.zh: 我很感激你的幫忙。

words.gloss: v. 接近 / n. 接近；方法

examples.en: As I approached the house, I noticed a light on upstairs.
examples.zh: 我接近這房子時，我注意到樓上有燈亮著。

examples.en: With the approach of the exam, students work harder.
examples.zh: 隨著考試逼近，學生們更用功了。

examples.en: I like her approach to the problem.
examples.zh: 我喜歡她解決這個問題的方法。

examples.en: I'm not going to argue with you tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚不想與你爭辯。

examples.en: There they formed an army of about two thousand men.
examples.zh: 他們在那裡組建了一支兩千人的軍隊。

examples.en: She arranged the flowers in a vase.
examples.zh: 她把花瓶裡的花插好。

examples.en: We waited for the arrival of our guests.
examples.zh: 我們等著客人的到來。

words.gloss: v. 飛速前進 / n. 箭

examples.en: He shot an arrow at the hare.
examples.zh: 他對準野兔射了一箭。

examples.en: She had several articles of clothing in her bag.
examples.zh: 她手提包內有幾件衣物。

examples.en: The artist's works were displayed at the museum.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家的作品在博物館展出。

examples.en: He seems to be fast asleep.
examples.zh: 他好像睡得很熟。

words.gloss: v. 試圖 / n. 試圖

examples.en: They attempted to finish the task before July.
examples.zh: 他們試圖在七月以前完成這項任務。

examples.en: The thief made no attempt to resist arrest.
examples.zh: 這名竊賊並未試圖拒捕。

examples.en: He did not attend the meeting yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天他沒有參加會議。

examples.en: There was no one to attend him, but Tina.
examples.zh: 除了蒂娜，沒有人可以照顧他了。

examples.en: Let me have your attention!
examples.zh: 請注意聽我講話！

words.gloss: n. 作者 / v. 寫作

examples.en: Mark Twain is his favorite author.
examples.zh: 馬克吐溫是他最愛的作家。

examples.en: He has authored more than 30 books.
examples.zh: 他寫了超過 30 本書。

examples.en: The swimming pool is available only in summer.
examples.zh: 這個游泳池只在夏天開放。

examples.en: Senator Collins was not available for comment.
examples.zh: 科林斯參議員沒有空發表意見。

words.gloss: n. 平均 / adj. 平均的

examples.en: An average of two students are absent each day.
examples.zh: 每天平均有兩個學生缺席。

examples.en: The average age of the US soldiers who fought in the Vietnam War was 19.
examples.zh: 參加越戰的美國士兵平均年齡是 19 歲。

examples.en: I avoided him as much as possible.
examples.zh: 我盡量避開他。

examples.en: Campers use backpacks to carry supplies.
examples.zh: 露營者用背包攜帶補給品。

examples.en: In some cities, housing conditions went backward.
examples.zh: 某些城市的住房條件越來越差。

examples.en: Badminton is popular among students in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 羽毛球受台灣學生歡迎。

examples.en: We bake bread and cake in an oven.
examples.zh: 我們用烤箱烘麵包與糕點。

examples.en: He works at a bakery.
examples.zh: 他在一家麵包房工作。

words.gloss: n. 平衡；結餘 / v. 保持平衡

examples.en: Try to strike a balance between work and play.
examples.zh: 工作和玩樂要保持平衡。

examples.en: My bank balance isn't good.
examples.zh: 我銀行存款的餘額不多。

examples.en: The flamingoes balanced gracefully on one leg.
examples.zh: 火鶴用單腳保持優雅平衡。

examples.en: You can see the sea from our balcony.
examples.zh: 從我們的陽台，你可以看到大海。

examples.en: The girl was startled when the balloon exploded.
examples.zh: 這女孩在氣球爆炸時吃了一驚。

examples.en: Here is a bar of soap.
examples.zh: 這兒有一條肥皂。

words.gloss: v. 烤肉 / n. 烤肉架；串燒肉

examples.en: We'll have a barbecue this Friday.
examples.zh: 這星期五我們要舉行烤肉野餐。

examples.en: I had a shave at the barber's.
examples.zh: 我在理髮店剃鬚修面。

words.gloss: v. 吠 / n. 吠聲；樹皮

examples.en: What are the dogs barking at?
examples.zh: 狗為何吠叫？

examples.en: The machine rests on a wide base of steel.
examples.zh: 這機器由一個很大的鋼製底座支承。

examples.en: These poor people lack the basic necessities of life.
examples.zh: 這些窮人缺乏生活的基本必需品。

examples.en: The school can't even afford basics such as books and paper.
examples.zh: 這所學校甚至無法提供書和紙這些基本東西。

examples.en: The basis of her opinion is something she read in the magazine.
examples.zh: 她意見的根據是從雜誌裡看來的。

examples.en: Will you help me bathe the baby?
examples.zh: 你能幫我替孩子洗澡嗎？

examples.en: The ringleader was shot to death in a gun battle.
examples.zh: 主犯在槍戰中被擊斃。

examples.en: Most beers are made from barley.
examples.zh: 多數種類的啤酒是用大麥釀製的。

examples.en: He beat his brother for lying.
examples.zh: 他因為他的兄弟說謊而揍他。

examples.en: He has no real feeling for beauty.
examples.zh: 他缺少真正的美感。

examples.en: From whom did he beg this money?
examples.zh: 他向誰討到這錢的？

examples.en: He is only a beginner of French. He doesn't know many French words.
examples.zh: 他只是法文的初學者，認識的法文字不多。

examples.en: The lady behaved courageously in the face of danger.
examples.zh: 那位女士面對危險表現十分勇敢。

examples.en: The mother told the children to behave themselves when she was not around.
examples.zh: 媽媽要孩子們她不在時守規矩。

examples.en: When did the universe come into being?
examples.zh: 宇宙最初是何時形成的？

examples.en: My father doesn't have much belief in doctors of traditional Chinese medicine.
examples.zh: 我父親不太相信中醫。

examples.en: He bent the iron bar as if it had been made of rubber.
examples.zh: 他將鐵棍折彎，彷彿那是用橡皮做成的。

examples.en: They wanted better housing.
examples.zh: 他們要求更好的住房。

examples.en: The house is beyond the bridge.
examples.zh: 房子在橋的另一邊。

examples.en: The store sent me a bill for $50.
examples.zh: 那家商店寄給我一張五十美元的帳單。

examples.en: Billions of stars twinkled in the sky.
examples.zh: 無數星星在天空閃爍。

examples.en: The exact date of his birth is not known.
examples.zh: 他確切的出生日期無人知道。

examples.en: Would you like some cheese and biscuits?
examples.zh: 要不要來點乳酪和餅乾？

examples.en: The dog was pulling the newspaper to bits.
examples.zh: 狗把報紙撕成了碎片。

examples.en: The teacher is writing some English words on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老師在黑板上寫下一些英文字。

words.gloss: v. 責怪 / n. 責任

examples.en: He blamed himself for his wife's death.
examples.zh: 他自責於妻子的死。

examples.en: He blamed his wife's death on himself.
examples.zh: 他把妻子的死歸罪於自己。

examples.en: If anything goes wrong, I'll take the blame.
examples.zh: 如果事情出錯就怪我好了。

words.gloss: n. 空格；空白 / adj. 空白的；無表情的

examples.en: He handed me a blank check.
examples.zh: 他遞給我一張空白支票。

examples.en: The valley was covered with a blanket of snow.
examples.zh: 山谷白雪如毯。

examples.en: Lots of people donated blood.
examples.zh: 許多人捐血。

examples.en: Jack came home with a bloody nose.
examples.zh: 傑克回家來了，鼻子流著血。

examples.en: He sawed the board in half.
examples.zh: 他將木板鋸成兩塊。

examples.en: The water is boiling.
examples.zh: 水開了。

examples.en: Doris suffered a broken bone in her foot.
examples.zh: 朵麗絲的一隻腳骨折了。

examples.en: The new edition is now available in all major bookstores.
examples.zh: 這個新版本現在在主要書店都有販售。

examples.en: The train crosses the border between France and Spain.
examples.zh: 這列火車跨過法國和西班牙國界。

examples.en: I can't bother him with my little affairs.
examples.zh: 我不能因自己那點小事去打擾他。

examples.en: I suppose she has more brains than any of us.
examples.zh: 我認為她比我們都聰明。

examples.en: The river has three main branches.
examples.zh: 這條河有三條主要的支流。

examples.en: This brand of tea is my favorite.
examples.zh: 這種茶我最愛喝。

examples.en: I bought a brick of ice cream for my daughter.
examples.zh: 我給女兒買了塊冰磚。

words.gloss: n. 簡報 / adj. 簡短的

examples.en: I'll make a brief visit to Paris.
examples.zh: 我將去巴黎作短時間的訪問。

words.gloss: adj. 傑出的；聰穎的；極好的；明亮的

examples.en: Marie Curie was a brilliant scientist.
examples.zh: 瑪麗．居里是個傑出的科學家。

examples.en: He came up with a brilliant idea.
examples.zh: 他想出了一個極好的主意。

examples.en: The broad highway has six traffic lanes.
examples.zh: 那條寬闊的公路有六線車道。

words.gloss: v. 刷；梳(頭髮) / n. 刷子；毛筆

examples.en: I paint with a brush.
examples.zh: 我用畫筆作畫。

examples.en: Taipei 101 is one of the world's tallest buildings.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是世上最高建築物之一。

words.gloss: n. 負擔 / v. 加負擔於

examples.en: My elderly mother worries that she is a burden on me.
examples.zh: 我年邁的母親擔心她是我的負擔。

examples.en: I don't want to burden you with my problems.
examples.zh: 我不想讓自己的問題成為你的負擔。

examples.en: The whole city was burned to the ground.
examples.zh: 整座城市都被燒光了。

examples.en: The balloon burst.
examples.zh: 氣球爆炸了。

examples.en: The cafe fills up with businessmen in suits and ties at lunch time.
examples.zh: 咖啡店午餐時間充滿穿西裝打領帶的商人。

examples.en: The cabbage grown on the mountain is very delicious.
examples.zh: 種在山上的高麗菜很好吃。

examples.en: We went into the cafe for coffee and dessert.
examples.zh: 我們到咖啡廳喝杯咖啡，吃些點心。

examples.en: The old man made a cage for birds.
examples.zh: 老人做了一只鳥籠。

examples.en: Today is her birthday according to the solar calendar.
examples.zh: 按照陽曆，今天是她的生日。

words.gloss: v. 使鎮靜 / n. 平穩；風平浪靜 / adj. 平靜的；冷靜的

examples.en: We calmed the old man down.
examples.zh: 我們使老先生平靜下來。

examples.en: the calm before the storm
examples.zh: 風雨前的寧靜

examples.en: You must try to be calm.
examples.zh: 你必須設法冷靜下來。

notes: calm down；clam 蛤蜊；claim 主張

examples.en: Camels are animals living in the desert.
examples.zh: 駱駝是住在沙漠中的動物。

examples.en: The ball game was canceled because of the rain.
examples.zh: 球賽因雨而取消了。

examples.en: The doctors are making an attempt to prevent cancer cells from spreading.
examples.zh: 醫生們試圖阻止癌細胞擴散。

examples.en: He blew out the candle and went to bed.
examples.zh: 他吹熄蠟燭，上床睡覺。

examples.en: Washington, D.C. is the capital city of the United States of America.
examples.zh: 華盛頓哥倫比亞特區是美利堅合眾國首都。

examples.en: This is one of the most vivid cartoons I have ever read.
examples.zh: 這是我看過最生動的漫畫之一。

words.gloss: v. 換成現金 / n. 現金

examples.en: I have no cash on me. Can I pay you later?
examples.zh: 我沒帶現金，能否以後付給你？

examples.en: The baron lived in a strong castle.
examples.zh: 男爵住在堅固的城堡中。

words.gloss: n. 理由 / v. 造成

examples.en: They are making a study of the causes of a depression.
examples.zh: 他們正在研究經濟蕭條的原因。

examples.en: The fire was caused by faulty wiring.
examples.zh: 這場火災因電線短路而引起。

examples.en: The new houses in this area have very high ceilings.
examples.zh: 這個地區的新房子天花板甚高。

examples.en: The prisoner was locked in a cell.
examples.zh: 那囚犯被關在單人牢房內。

examples.en: A meter equals one hundred centimeters.
examples.zh: 一公尺等於一百公分。

examples.en: The railroad station is in the central part of the city.
examples.zh: 火車站在該城的中心。

examples.en: We live in the twenty-first century.
examples.zh: 我們生活在二十一世紀。

examples.en: I've just bought a box of cereal.
examples.zh: 我剛買了一盒麥片。

words.gloss: n. 鏈；一系列 / v. 用鎖鏈拴住

examples.en: Pollution affects creatures lower down the food chain.
examples.zh: 污染影響了食物鏈下層的生物。

examples.en: She built up 100 chain stores across the country.
examples.zh: 她在全國建立了百家連鎖店。

examples.en: Their hands and feet were chained together.
examples.zh: 他們的手腳被鎖鏈鎖在一起。

examples.en: Teachers usually write on the blackboard with chalk.
examples.zh: 教師通常用粉筆在黑板上書寫。

words.gloss: n. 挑戰 / v. 挑戰；質疑；盤問

examples.en: He now faces the biggest challenge of his career.
examples.zh: 他正面臨事業上最大的挑戰。

examples.en: He enjoys challenging the authority of his teachers.
examples.zh: 他喜歡挑戰老師的權威。

examples.en: Scientists challenged the accuracy of his findings.
examples.zh: 科學家們質疑他的研究發現的正確性。

examples.en: He switched to another channel to watch the football.
examples.zh: 他轉台看足球。

examples.en: Complaints should be made through proper channels.
examples.zh: 申訴要經由正常管道。

notes: Channel 英吉利海峽；canal 運河

examples.en: Read chapters 1 through 4 of the book.
examples.zh: 請閱讀該書的第一章至第四章。

examples.en: Teachers usually write on the blackboard with chalk.
examples.zh: 教師通常用粉筆在黑板上書寫。

examples.en: He has a changeable character.
examples.zh: 他性格多變。

words.gloss: v. 向…索費；指控 / n. 費用

examples.en: This store charges only 65 cents a dozen for large eggs.
examples.zh: 一打大雞蛋在這家店裡僅賣六角五分。

examples.en: He was arrested on a charge of murder.
examples.zh: 他因被指控謀殺而被捕。

examples.en: The chart showed the company's growth in recent years.
examples.zh: 圖表顯示了該公司近年來的發展。

examples.en: The cat chased the mouse.
examples.zh: 貓追老鼠。

examples.en: They cheated the old woman out of her house and money.
examples.zh: 他們騙取了老婦人的房屋和錢財。

words.gloss: v. 喝采；使振奮 / n. 歡呼

examples.en: All the parents come to cheer their kids on.
examples.zh: 家長都來為孩子加油。

examples.en: Here's a bit of news that will cheer you up.
examples.zh: 有好消息可振奮你的精神。

examples.en: A cheer arose from the crowd when the president appeared.
examples.zh: 當總統露面時，人群中發出了歡呼聲。

words.gloss: n. 化學藥品 / adj. 化學的

examples.en: He devoted his life to chemical research.
examples.zh: 他一生從事化學研究。

examples.en: Bill likes to play chess with his friends on the weekend.
examples.zh: 比爾喜歡和朋友在週末時下西洋棋。

examples.en: The president is also the chief of the armed forces.
examples.zh: 總統也是三軍的統帥。

examples.en: She recalled her childhood memories of playing hide-and-seek.
examples.zh: 她回憶起童年玩捉迷藏的記憶。

examples.en: She had a childish face.
examples.zh: 她的臉上帶有一些稚氣。

examples.en: The clerks are careful in wrapping china plates because they break easily.
examples.zh: 店員在包裝時很小心，因為瓷碟易碎。

examples.en: It is not easy for the Westerners to learn to use chopsticks.
examples.zh: 對西方人而言，要學會拿筷子並不容易。

words.gloss: n. 要求；聲明 / v. 奪走生命

examples.en: Mary made a claim to the pencil.
examples.zh: 瑪麗認為這枝鉛筆是她的。

examples.en: The tornado claimed dozens of lives.
examples.zh: 那場龍捲風奪走幾十條人命。

examples.en: The audience clapped the pianist heartily.
examples.zh: 聽眾熱情地為鋼琴演奏者鼓掌。

examples.en: That joke of Henry is a classic.
examples.zh: 亨利的那個笑話真是經典。

examples.en: She prefers pop music and jazz to classical music.
examples.zh: 她喜歡流行音樂與爵士音樂勝於古典音樂。

examples.en: The freshman of senior high school bumped into his former classmate the other day.
examples.zh: 這位高一新生前幾天偶遇以前的同學。

examples.en: She knew him to be industrious and clever.
examples.zh: 她知道他既勤奮又聰明。

words.gloss: n. 喀嚓聲；用滑鼠點選 / v. 發喀嚓聲；用滑鼠點選

examples.en: The lock opened with a click.
examples.zh: 鎖「喀嚓」一聲開了。

examples.en: Your photos can be viewed with the click of a mouse.
examples.zh: 滑鼠點選可看到照片。

examples.en: They smiled as the cameras clicked.
examples.zh: 照相機喀嚓響時他們笑了。

examples.en: Click on a sentence to hear it read aloud.
examples.zh: 點選句子可聽到該句被唸出。

examples.en: He could not stand the terrible English climate.
examples.zh: 他忍受不了糟糕的英國氣候。

examples.en: The table cloth is pretty.
examples.zh: 桌巾很漂亮。

examples.en: The staff at this hotel wear uniform clothing.
examples.zh: 這家飯店的員工穿統一的制服。

examples.en: The sky was cloudy, so I took my umbrella.
examples.zh: 天陰，所以我帶了把傘。

examples.en: Let's burn some coal to keep ourselves warm.
examples.zh: 讓我們燒些煤炭來取暖吧。

examples.en: They live in a town along the coast.
examples.zh: 他們住在一個沿海的城市裡。

examples.en: Most women hate cockroaches.
examples.zh: 大多數女人討厭蟑螂。

examples.en: Bill collects foreign coins.
examples.zh: 比爾收集外國硬幣。

examples.en: Which do you want? Cola or Sprite?
examples.zh: 你要什麼？可樂還是雪碧？

examples.en: You will go to college after graduating from high school.
examples.zh: 你高中畢業後會上大學。

examples.en: We were great friends back in college.
examples.zh: 我們大學時代是好朋友。

words.gloss: n. 梳子 / v. 梳理

examples.en: My hair needs a good comb.
examples.zh: 我的頭髮需要好好梳理一番。

examples.en: Some films combine education with recreation.
examples.zh: 有些電影把教育與娛樂結合起來。

words.gloss: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的；有趣的 / n. 漫畫

examples.en: It was a comic situation when we found out that we had bought each other the same thing for Christmas.
examples.zh: 當我們發現給彼此的聖誕禮物一模一樣時，情況真是滑稽好笑。

examples.en: The retired teacher likes to read the Sunday comics in the paper.
examples.zh: 這位退休的老師喜歡看星期天報紙的漫畫。

words.gloss: v. 命令 / n. 掌握

examples.en: I command that he (should) go at once.
examples.zh: 我命令他即刻就去。

examples.en: She has a good command of the English language.
examples.zh: 她精通英文。

words.gloss: adj. 商業的 / n. 廣告節目

examples.en: Guangzhou is the commercial capital of China's Pearl River area.
examples.zh: 廣州是中國珠江流域的商業首府。

examples.en: We'll be right back with you after a commercial (break).
examples.zh: 我們廣告後立刻回來。

examples.en: Tom works for a computer company.
examples.zh: 湯姆在一家電腦公司上班。

examples.en: Compared with him, I am a bungler.
examples.zh: 與他相比，我只能算是一個笨拙的人。

words.gloss: adj. 完整的 / v. 使完整；完成

examples.en: We can't go out until our homework is complete.
examples.zh: 我們把作業做完才能出去。

examples.en: This problem is quite complex. There is no easy answer.
examples.zh: 這個問題相當複雜，不容易回答。

words.gloss: n. 擔心；關心 / v. 使…擔心；和…有關

examples.en: There is a growing concern over the safety of mobile phones.
examples.zh: 大家日益擔心使用手機的安全性。

examples.en: His main concern is to be able to support his family.
examples.zh: 他最在意的是要能養家。

examples.en: His behavior is starting to concern his parents.
examples.zh: 他的行為開始讓父母擔心。

examples.en: What I have to say to her does not concern you.
examples.zh: 我要和她講的話和你無關。

examples.en: He concluded from his studies that equality between the sexes is still a long way off.
examples.zh: 他從研究得出一個結論，就是兩性平等之路還很漫長。

examples.en: The miners worked in awful conditions.
examples.zh: 礦工在惡劣的環境中工作。

examples.en: He lent me the money on condition that I paid it back within three weeks.
examples.zh: 他借我錢，條件是我得三週內歸還。

examples.en: He was confident of his ability to get work for himself.
examples.zh: 他自信有能力為自己找到工作。

words.gloss: n. 衝突 / v. 矛盾

examples.en: Armed conflict is likely to break out between the two countries.
examples.zh: 兩國間可能爆發武裝衝突。

examples.en: She received their congratulations with pleasure.
examples.zh: 她很高興收到他們的祝賀。

examples.en: There is a strong connection between a positive attitude and personal success.
examples.zh: 積極的態度與個人的成功之間有強烈的關聯。

examples.en: I've begun to consider what to do next.
examples.zh: 我已在考慮下一步該怎麼辦。

examples.en: We'll take your recent illness into consideration when marking your exams.
examples.zh: 改你的考卷的時候我們會把你最近生病列入考慮。

words.gloss: n. 接觸 / v. 聯絡

examples.en: He tried in vain to get into contact with the local branch.
examples.zh: 他試圖與當地分部取得聯絡，但沒有成功。

examples.en: The jar contains ten glasses of water.
examples.zh: 這隻大口瓶能裝十杯水。

examples.en: The forest continues for miles.
examples.zh: 森林綿延數哩。

words.gloss: n. 契約 / v. 傳染；收縮

examples.en: They may take legal action if you break the contract.
examples.zh: 如果你毀約他們可能採取法律行動。

examples.en: He contracted malaria while traveling in the rain forest.
examples.zh: 他在雨林旅行的時候感染瘧疾。

examples.en: Metal contracts as it cools.
examples.zh: 金屬遇冷收縮。

words.gloss: v. 控制 / n. 管理

examples.en: She is skillful enough to control the machine now.
examples.zh: 現在她已有了足夠的技術可以操縱這臺機器了。

examples.en: He got into conversation with his neighbor.
examples.zh: 他開始與鄰居交談起來。

examples.en: Corn is the main food for some Indians.
examples.zh: 有些印地安人以玉米為主食。

examples.en: He grew up in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他在農村長大。

examples.en: The young couple decided to start their tour immediately.
examples.zh: 那對年輕夫婦決定立即開始旅遊。

examples.en: He didn't have the courage to tell me that he had failed in the exam.
examples.zh: 他沒有勇氣告訴我他考試不及格。

words.gloss: n. 法院；庭院；(網球、籃球)球場

examples.en: The court found him guilty.
examples.zh: 法庭判他有罪。

examples.en: See you next time at the tennis court.
examples.zh: 下回網球場上見。

examples.en: He loved to see cowboy movies.
examples.zh: 他愛看牛仔影片。

examples.en: Young children like to draw with crayon.
examples.zh: 小孩喜歡用蠟筆作畫。

examples.en: Butter is made from cream.
examples.zh: 奶油是從乳脂中提取而成的。

examples.en: An artist should create beautiful things.
examples.zh: 一個藝術家應該創造美麗的東西。

examples.en: He committed a serious crime.
examples.zh: 他犯下重大罪行。

examples.en: The economic crisis lasted for several years.
examples.zh: 經濟危機持續了好幾年。

examples.en: Crows are usually associated with bad luck because of their black feathers.
examples.zh: 烏鴉常因他們的黑羽毛而被與惡運聯想在一起。

examples.en: There was a crowd of people in front of the city hall.
examples.zh: 市政廳前有一群人。

examples.en: Students need to have time for relaxation and cultural activities.
examples.zh: 學生需要有時間放鬆及並從事文化活動。

words.gloss: n. 文化；修養 / v. 耕種；培養

examples.en: He has studied the cultures of various western countries.
examples.zh: 他研究了各種西方國家的文化。

examples.en: Antibiotics help to cure many diseases that were formerly fatal.
examples.zh: 抗生素有助於治癒許多以前會是致命的疾病。

examples.en: The boy was curious about everything he saw.
examples.zh: 那男孩對所見的一切都感到好奇。

examples.en: Our current methods of production cost too much.
examples.zh: 我們現今用的生產方法太花錢了。

examples.en: Please draw the curtains.
examples.zh: 請把窗簾拉上。

words.gloss: n. 風俗習慣；海關(常用複數形)

examples.en: The celebration of Christmas is a custom.
examples.zh: 慶祝耶誕節是一種風俗。

examples.en: The customs officers seized the smuggled heroin.
examples.zh: 海關官員沒收了走私的海洛因。

examples.en: The store has a lot of regular customers.
examples.zh: 這家商店有許多老主顧。

examples.en: The seasons of the year make a cycle.
examples.zh: 一年四季構成一個循環。

examples.en: These workers are paid on a daily basis.
examples.zh: 這些工人領的是日薪。

examples.en: The earthquake caused great damage.
examples.zh: 地震造成了極大的損害。

examples.en: I hope to become a dancer in the future.
examples.zh: 我希望長大以後當舞蹈家。

examples.en: He is in danger of losing his job if he goes on like this.
examples.zh: 他再這樣下去會丟掉工作的。

examples.en: We have not collected enough data to support this theory.
examples.zh: 我們尚未蒐集足夠的數據來支持這項理論。

examples.en: We must get up at dawn.
examples.zh: 我們必須天一亮就起來。

examples.en: She is deaf in one ear.
examples.zh: 她一隻耳朵是聾的。

examples.en: They debated the question openly.
examples.zh: 他們公開辯論這個問題。

examples.en: He has a lot of old debts to meet.
examples.zh: 他有許多舊債要償付。

examples.en: It was a sudden decision.
examples.zh: 這是一個突然的決定。

examples.en: I saw some deer in the forest.
examples.zh: 我在森林中看到一些鹿。

examples.en: Water freezes at zero degrees Centigrade.
examples.zh: 水在攝氏零度結冰。

examples.en: He was reading for a university degree.
examples.zh: 他正在攻讀大學學位。

examples.en: The accident delayed the train for two hours.
examples.zh: 事故使火車耽擱了兩小時。

examples.en: The fried chicken is delicious.
examples.zh: 這炸雞味道鮮美。

examples.en: The mailman delivered the letters promptly.
examples.zh: 那個郵差迅速地投遞信件。

examples.en: Most Chinese restaurants offer free delivery.
examples.zh: 大部分的中國餐館提供免費送外送的服務。

examples.en: My girlfriend's father is a dentist by profession.
examples.zh: 我女友的父親的職業是牙醫。

examples.en: I do not deny that is a serious blow.
examples.zh: 我不否認那是嚴重的一擊。

examples.en: She's the head of the firm's personnel department.
examples.zh: 她是公司人事部門的負責人。

examples.en: I knew he wasn't to be depended on.
examples.zh: 我知道他不可信賴。

examples.en: The young man dived to a depth of 40 feet.
examples.zh: 那個青年人潛到四十呎的深度。

examples.en: Words cannot describe the beauty of the scene.
examples.zh: 語言難以描述那景色之美麗。

examples.en: He gave a clear description of what he had seen.
examples.zh: 他對看到的情況作了清楚的描述。

words.gloss: n. 沙漠；荒蕪 / v. 離棄；擅自離開

examples.en: Nobody likes to live in that desert region.
examples.zh: 沒有人喜歡生活在那個沙漠地區。

examples.en: The man deserted his family and never came back.
examples.zh: 那男子拋棄家庭，沒有再回來。

examples.en: Architects design buildings.
examples.zh: 建築師設計房屋。

examples.en: He described the process in detail.
examples.zh: 他詳細描述這個過程。

examples.en: He wouldn't go into details over the phone.
examples.zh: 他不願意在電話中詳談。

examples.en: Swimming develops the muscles.
examples.zh: 游泳能使肌肉發達。

words.gloss: v. 撥號 / n. 刻度盤；轉盤

examples.en: The clock dial shines at night.
examples.zh: 那鐘面是夜光的。

examples.en: Plays are written in dialogue.
examples.zh: 劇本用對白寫成。

examples.en: She wore her diamonds to the party.
examples.zh: 她戴著鑽石首飾去參加宴會。

examples.en: I don't see why you should keep a diary at all.
examples.zh: 我不明白你為何要記日記。

examples.en: It's important to have a balanced diet.
examples.zh: 均衡飲食很重要。

examples.en: I'm going on a diet and hope to lose two kilos.
examples.zh: 我在節食，希望能瘦兩公斤。

examples.en: Whether it rains or not makes no difference to me.
examples.zh: 下不下雨對我來說都一樣。

examples.en: I had no difficulty in getting in touch with him.
examples.zh: 我和他取得聯繫沒有什麼困難。

examples.en: The public wanted a direct answer.
examples.zh: 大眾需要一個坦白的答案。

examples.en: He drove in the direction of the farm.
examples.zh: 他向該農場方向駛去。

examples.en: Lee-An is a world famous director from Taiwan.
examples.zh: 李安是來自台灣的世界知名導演。

examples.en: We disagreed in our solutions to the problem.
examples.zh: 我們對這個問題的解法不一致。

examples.en: The burglar disappeared into the dark.
examples.zh: 竊賊消失在黑暗中。

examples.en: She discovered that the man was a quack.
examples.zh: 她發現那人是個庸醫。

examples.en: Leonardo da Vinci made many scientific discoveries.
examples.zh: 達文西有許多科學上的發現。

examples.en: They discussed how to promote cooperation between the two countries.
examples.zh: 他們討論如何促進兩國間的合作。

examples.en: We had a discussion on language and communication.
examples.zh: 我們就語言和交際問題進行了討論。

examples.en: She caught the disease while she was abroad on holiday.
examples.zh: 她出國度假的時候得到這個病。

examples.en: Children enjoy a fireworks display.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜愛看煙火。

examples.en: It is a long distance from New York to Hongkong.
examples.zh: 紐約離香港很遠。

examples.en: The sun is distant from the earth.
examples.zh: 太陽距地球很遙遠。

examples.en: The teacher divided our class into four groups.
examples.zh: 老師把我們班分成四個小組。

examples.en: The compilers agreed upon a division of the textbook into twelve units.
examples.zh: 編輯者都同意把教科書分成十二個單元。

examples.en: Domestic flights and international flights depart from different terminals.
examples.zh: 國內航班跟國際航班由不同航廈出發。

examples.en: Statistics indicate domestic violence is on the increase.
examples.zh: 數據顯示家暴的案件正在增加。

examples.en: She watched the train until it became a dot in the distance.
examples.zh: 她一直看著火車，直到它走遠了，成了遠方的一個小點。

words.gloss: v. 乘以兩倍 / n. 兩倍 / adj./adv. 兩倍的

examples.en: I'll give you double pay for working overtime.
examples.zh: 你加班我付你雙倍工錢。

words.gloss: n. 懷疑；疑惑 / v. 懷疑

examples.en: I doubt whether she told the truth.
examples.zh: 我懷疑她是否說實話。

examples.en: Doves will spread diseases.
examples.zh: 鴿子會傳染疾病。

words.gloss: v. 下載 / n. 下載(的檔案)

examples.en: Many games can be downloaded free.
examples.zh: 網路上可以免費下載許多遊戲。

examples.en: I got downloads of the latest version.
examples.zh: 我有最新版的下載。

words.gloss: adj. 樓下的 / adv. 在樓下；往樓下

examples.en: Mary's on the phone downstairs.
examples.zh: 瑪麗在樓下打電話。

examples.en: In ancient China, dragons used to be the symbol of the emperor.
examples.zh: 在古代中國龍被視為皇帝的象徵。

examples.en: She is a student of drama.
examples.zh: 她攻讀戲劇。

examples.en: I put it in the left-hand drawer.
examples.zh: 我將它放在左手的抽屜內。

examples.en: My friend is good at drawing.
examples.zh: 我的朋友擅長畫畫。

examples.en: Why not try this new drug?
examples.zh: 為什麼不試一試這種新藥？

examples.en: She bought an electric hair dryer.
examples.zh: 她買了個吹風機。

examples.en: The rent is due at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 房租月底到期。

examples.en: My paper is due on December 31.
examples.zh: 我的報告 12 月 31 日到期。

examples.en: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.
examples.zh: 只工作不玩耍，聰明孩子也變傻。

examples.en: I wish I could fly as freely as an eagle.
examples.zh: 我希望能像老鷹一樣自由翱翔。

examples.en: It is our duty to defend our country.
examples.zh: 保衛國家是我們的義務。

examples.en: We bought cigarettes at a duty-free shop.
examples.zh: 我們在免稅商店買香菸。

examples.en: How much do you earn a week?
examples.zh: 你一週賺多少錢？

examples.en: You must show your annual earnings in the tax form.
examples.zh: 你必須在稅單上註明你的年收入。

examples.en: The town was destroyed by the earthquake.
examples.zh: 整座城鎮被地震毀滅了。

examples.en: Their team won the game with ease.
examples.zh: 他們隊輕鬆地贏了那場比賽。

words.gloss: adj. 東方的 / n. 東方人

examples.en: He is interested in Eastern philosophy.
examples.zh: 他對東方哲學感興趣。

examples.en: They lived in a house on the edge of a forest.
examples.zh: 他們住在森林邊緣一所房子裡。

examples.en: A paperback edition is usually cheaper than a hardback edition.
examples.zh: 平裝本通常比精裝本便宜。

examples.en: The government's policy on higher education is a success.
examples.zh: 政府的高等教育政策很成功。

examples.en: This had a great effect on the future of both mother and son.
examples.zh: 這對母子倆的將來影響很大。

examples.en: Screen windows are effective in keeping out mosquitoes.
examples.zh: 紗窗能有效地擋住蚊子。

examples.en: I decided to make one more effort.
examples.zh: 我決定再作一次努力。

words.gloss: adj. 資格老的；地位高的

examples.en: An elder educator is due to lecture at 3 tomorrow afternoon.
examples.zh: 一位資深教育家定於明天下午三點演講。

examples.zh: 我被這根電線電擊了一下。

examples.zh: 伯朗先生經營一家小鋪，修理電器用品。

examples.en: Love, hatred, and grief are all emotions.
examples.zh: 愛、恨和悲都是情感。

examples.en: The importance of recycling can't be emphasized too much.
examples.zh: 回收的重要性怎麼強調都不為過。

examples.zh: 她被雇來當褓姆。

examples.zh: 這個實驗使用了好幾個方法。

examples.en: The firm has 1000 employees.
examples.zh: 這家公司有一千名員工。

examples.en: The shoe factory is a major employer in this area.
examples.zh: 該鞋廠是這一地區的大雇主。

words.gloss: adj. 空的；未佔用的 / v. 清空

examples.en: You shouldn't go to school on an empty stomach.
examples.zh: 你不該空腹上學。

examples.en: I spotted an empty table in the corner.
examples.zh: 我看到角落有張桌子沒人用。

examples.en: Please empty your pocket.
examples.zh: 請把你口袋中的東西全掏出來。

examples.en: She encouraged him to talk to her.
examples.zh: 她鼓勵他與她交談。

examples.en: The story has a surprise ending.
examples.zh: 這個故事的結尾出人意料。

examples.en: Don't make an enemy of him.
examples.zh: 不要與他為敵。

examples.en: They devoted all their energies to the job.
examples.zh: 他們把全副精力投入這項工作。

examples.en: The engine is running smoothly.
examples.zh: 引擎轉動很順利。

examples.en: It took us an entire week to finish painting the house.
examples.zh: 我們花了整整一星期的時間才把房子粉刷好。

examples.en: We used the back entrance to the building.
examples.zh: 我們是從大樓的後門入口走進去的。

examples.en: Children need a happy home environment.
examples.zh: 孩子們需要愉快的家庭環境。

examples.en: Environmental issues were addressed in the meeting.
examples.zh: 在會議中討論了環保議題。

examples.en: Not all men are equal in ability.
examples.zh: 人的能力不都是一樣的。

words.gloss: v. 逃跑 / n. 逃脫

examples.en: The soldier escaped from the enemy's prison.
examples.zh: 這個士兵從敵人的監獄裡逃了出來。

examples.en: We got out in time, but it was a narrow escape.
examples.zh: 我們及時逃出，但是很險。

examples.en: We need to be especially careful.
examples.zh: 我們需要特別小心。

examples.en: The professor wrote an essay on Homer.
examples.zh: 這位教授寫了一篇關於荷馬的文章。

examples.en: They held a party on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 他們在除夕舉行了跨年晚會。

examples.en: Winning the scholarship was a great event in the boy's life.
examples.zh: 贏得這項獎學金是這個男孩一生中的一件大事。

words.gloss: adj. 邪惡的；魔鬼的 / n. 邪惡；罪惡

examples.en: Chinese people believe that the color red could scare away evil spirits.
examples.zh: 中國人相信紅色可以嚇走惡鬼。

examples.en: She wanted to protect her children from the evils of the outside world.
examples.zh: 她想保護孩子不讓他們接觸到外面世界的邪惡。

examples.en: It was difficult to tell her exact age.
examples.zh: 很難說出她的確實年齡。

examples.en: The teacher gave us an examination in history.
examples.zh: 教師對我們進行了歷史考試。

examples.en: The doctor examined the boy and found there was nothing the matter with him.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了男孩的身體發現他是健康的。

examples.en: The news excited everybody.
examples.zh: 這消息使每個人都興奮了起來。

words.gloss: n. 理由；藉口 / v. 原諒

examples.en: Nobody believed his made-up excuse.
examples.zh: 沒有人相信他編造的藉口。

examples.en: Please excuse the offence this time. I will not do it again.
examples.zh: 請原諒這次冒犯，我以後再也不會了。

examples.en: That word doesn't exist in English.
examples.zh: 英語中沒有這個字。

examples.en: The organization has been in existence for 25 years.
examples.zh: 這個機構已經存在 25 年了。

examples.en: There is a fire exit on each floor of the building.
examples.zh: 這棟建築物每層樓都有消防通道。

examples.en: They made a quick exit when they saw the police coming.
examples.zh: 他們看到警察來了立刻離開。

examples.en: I don't think we can afford the expense.
examples.zh: 我認為我們負擔不了此費用。

examples.en: We've just had a new garage built at great expense.
examples.zh: 我們花了一大筆錢蓋了一個新車庫。

examples.en: She is an expert in training animals.
examples.zh: 她是馴獸專家。

words.gloss: v. 表達 / n. 直達車；快遞

examples.en: Really, I hardly know how to express my gratitude.
examples.zh: 我真不知道如何表達我的感激之情。

examples.en: I sent them flowers as an expression of gratitude.
examples.zh: 我給他們送去鮮花表示感謝。

examples.en: There was a blank expression on her face.
examples.zh: 她面無表情。

words.gloss: adj. 額外的 / adv. 額外地 / n. 附加費用

examples.en: I don't suppose they need any extra help.
examples.zh: 我想他們不需要額外幫助。

examples.en: I can't go to the movie—I am up to my eyebrows.
examples.zh: 我不能去看電影，我很忙很忙。

examples.en: The weather could be a key factor in tomorrow's game.
examples.zh: 天氣會是明天比賽的決定性因素。

examples.en: He was doomed to failure.
examples.zh: 他注定要失敗。

words.gloss: adj. 公正的；晴朗的 / n. 展覽會；市集

examples.en: That's a fair comment.
examples.zh: 那是公正的評價。

examples.en: There is a fair in the town square.
examples.zh: 市中心廣場有個市集。

words.gloss: adj. 錯誤的；虛偽的；假的

examples.en: What you're saying is false.
examples.zh: 你所說的是假的。

examples.en: Long hair is back in fashion for men.
examples.zh: 男人又開始流行留長髮了。

examples.en: I want to decide my own fate.
examples.zh: 我要決定自己的命運。

examples.en: Every man has his faults.
examples.zh: 人無聖賢，孰能無過。

examples.en: They will look with favor on your proposal.
examples.zh: 他們將會贊同你的建議。

words.gloss: n. 特別喜歡的人/物 / adj. 特別喜愛的

examples.en: Lester, the second son, was his father's favorite.
examples.zh: 二兒子列斯特是他父親的寵兒。

words.gloss: n. 恐怖 / v. 害怕

examples.en: She has a great fear of water.
examples.zh: 她很怕水。

words.gloss: n. 特徵；特色 / v. 描述…的特色；電影由…主演

examples.en: This is a key feature of our society.
examples.zh: 這是我們社會的一個主要特點。

examples.en: This documentary features the life in Africa.
examples.zh: 這部記錄片描述非洲生活。

examples.en: This film features Brad Pitt.
examples.zh: 這部電影由布萊德彼特主演。

examples.en: They charge a small registration fee.
examples.zh: 他們收一點註冊費。

examples.en: The cold made him lose feeling in his fingers.
examples.zh: 他的手指被凍麻了。

examples.en: A fellow must eat.
examples.zh: 人總得吃飯。

examples.en: Sewing is considered a female occupation.
examples.zh: 縫紉被認為是女性的職業。

examples.en: He had a slight fever.
examples.zh: 他有點發燒。

examples.en: They were working in the cotton fields.
examples.zh: 他們在棉田裡幹活。

words.gloss: v. 計算 / n. 數字；人物；身材

examples.en: Please help me to figure out my income tax.
examples.zh: 請幫我算一下我的所得稅。

examples.en: This is your final chance.
examples.zh: 這是你的最後一次機會。

examples.en: Firemen are rescuers who are trained in firefighting.
examples.zh: 消防隊員是受過打火訓練的營救員。

words.gloss: adj. 堅定的；穩固的 / n. 公司

examples.en: I don't think the chair is firm enough to stand on.
examples.zh: 我覺得這椅子不夠穩固，不能站人。

examples.en: Fisherman's Wharf is a tourist's attraction in San Francisco.
examples.zh: 漁人碼頭是舊金山的觀光名勝。

words.gloss: v. 適宜 / n. (咳嗽或笑的)發作（fit-fit-fit）

examples.en: This dress doesn't fit me.
examples.zh: 這件衣服不適合我穿。

examples.en: The patient had a fit of coughing.
examples.zh: 病人咳了好一會兒。

examples.en: We are going to have the TV fixed.
examples.zh: 我們要請人把電視修好。

examples.en: The ship carried the national flag of Greece.
examples.zh: 那條船懸著希臘國旗。

words.gloss: adj. 平坦的；單調的 / n. (英)公寓

examples.en: Of course, no one now believes that the earth is flat.
examples.zh: 當然如今無人相信地球是平的。

examples.en: The enemies are in flight.
examples.zh: 敵人逃跑了。

words.gloss: n. 流動 / v. 漲潮

examples.en: The tide is on the flow.
examples.zh: 現在正在漲潮。

examples.en: I was too weak to work due to flu.
examples.zh: 我因患流行性感冒身體虛弱不能工作。

words.gloss: v. 集中 / n. 焦點

examples.en: When reading a poem, focus on the image portrayed by the words.
examples.zh: 讀詩時要專注在文字所描繪的意象。

examples.en: The ships cast anchor because of the heavy fog.
examples.zh: 船因濃霧拋錨。

words.gloss: n. 人們 / adj. 民俗的

examples.en: I'd like a job working with old folk(s) of kids.
examples.zh: 我想要與老人或小孩打交道的工作。

examples.en: folk dance/tale/medicine
examples.zh: 民俗舞蹈/民間故事/民俗療法

examples.en: He did it for the following reasons.
examples.zh: 他這樣做有下面幾個原因。

examples.en: How foolish I was not to have bought it!
examples.zh: 我沒買下它真是太傻！

examples.en: He is on the college football team.
examples.zh: 他是大學橄欖球隊的隊員。

examples.en: The moral force is on our side.
examples.zh: 道義的力量在我們這一邊。

examples.en: Most of the ancient forests in the world have been destroyed.
examples.zh: 世界上大多數原始森林都被毀壞了。

examples.en: We forgave him his rudeness.
examples.zh: 我們原諒了他的無禮。

examples.en: Playing badminton is one form of physical exercise.
examples.zh: 打籃球是體育活動的一種形式。

examples.en: The letter was formal in its wording.
examples.zh: 此信措辭正式。

examples.en: In former days there was a racecourse here.
examples.zh: 從前這兒有個賽馬場。

examples.en: When we asked for volunteers, many young men came forth.
examples.zh: 我們詢問有無志願者時，很多年輕人都站了出來。

words.gloss: adv. 向前 / v. 轉寄

examples.en: He hurried forward to meet her.
examples.zh: 他趕緊走上前去迎接她。

examples.en: Would you please forward this letter to his new address?
examples.zh: 可以請你把這封信轉寄到他的新地址嗎？

examples.en: Please step forward(s).
examples.zh: 請往前走。

examples.en: The pilgrims founded a colony in Plymouth.
examples.zh: 清教徒們在普利茅斯創建了一個殖民地。

examples.en: Be on your guard! He's a sly old fox.
examples.zh: 提高警覺，他是一個狡猾的老狐狸。

examples.en: The poor cried out for their freedom from hunger.
examples.zh: 窮人要求免於飢餓的自由。

examples.en: Their friendship was as close as it had been.
examples.zh: 他們的友誼跟以往一樣親密。

examples.en: The teenagers rushed in a fast food restaurant and ordered hamburgers with fries.
examples.zh: 青少年們快速進去一間速食店並點了漢堡配薯條。

examples.en: She had fried eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她早餐吃煎蛋。

examples.en: The teacher did not explain its grammatical function.
examples.zh: 老師沒有解釋它的文法功能。

examples.en: The only piece of furniture in his bedroom is a bed.
examples.zh: 他房間裡僅有的一件傢俱是張床。

words.gloss: adj./adv. 進一步的/地；較遠的/地

examples.en: Do you need further help?
examples.zh: 你還需要幫忙嗎？

words.gloss: v. 獲得 / n. 利潤

examples.en: We all gained from the experience.
examples.zh: 我們都從這次經驗中獲益。

examples.en: No gain without pain.
examples.zh: 不勞則無獲。

examples.en: The garbage can is already full.
examples.zh: 垃圾桶早就滿了。

examples.en: Mrs. White is a very good gardener.
examples.zh: 懷特太太是位很好的園丁。

examples.en: Garlic is very rich in Vitamin C and Vitamin B6.
examples.zh: 大蒜富含維生素 C 及維生素 B6。

examples.en: A crowd gathered at the scene of the accident.
examples.zh: 出事地點聚集了一群人。

words.gloss: adj. 一般的；普遍的 / n. 將軍

examples.en: His theories met with general discredits.
examples.zh: 他的理論遭到普遍的懷疑。

examples.en: She is generous in giving help.
examples.zh: 她樂於助人。

examples.en: He was a man gentle in manner but firm in action.
examples.zh: 他是一個舉止文雅但行動堅決的人。

examples.en: He is a perfect gentleman.
examples.zh: 他是一個十足的君子。

examples.en: A giraffe is characterized by its long neck.
examples.zh: 長頸鹿的特徵是長頸子。

examples.en: Can you glue the broken vase together?
examples.zh: 你能把破碎的花瓶黏合起來嗎？

examples.en: They reached the goal of their journey.
examples.zh: 他們到達了旅程的終點。

examples.en: She is too young to separate the sheep from the goats.
examples.zh: 她太年輕分不清楚好人和壞人(山羊代表壞人)。

examples.en: People used to pay in gold.
examples.zh: 人們過去以黃金支付。

examples.en: She has bright golden hair.
examples.zh: 她有一頭明亮的金髮。

examples.en: We saw a flock of geese swimming in the lake.
examples.zh: 我們看見一群鵝在湖裡游水。

examples.en: Who really governs this country?
examples.zh: 誰真正統治著這個國家？

examples.en: The government is discussing the proposal.
examples.zh: 政府在討論這一提議。

examples.en: There has been a gradual change in climate in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來氣候逐漸改變。

examples.en: Whole grains are an essential part of a healthy diet.
examples.zh: 全穀穀物對健康飲食至為重要。

examples.en: Not a grain of rice was wasted.
examples.zh: 一粒米也沒有浪費。

examples.en: One thousand grams are equal to one kilogram.
examples.zh: 一千克等於一公斤。

examples.en: Wine is made from grapes.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒是葡萄釀成的。

examples.en: The hostess greeted her guests at the door.
examples.zh: 女主人在門口迎接客人。

examples.en: Exercise and good food are important to the proper growth of a child.
examples.zh: 運動和營養好的食物對孩子的正常發育十分重要。

words.gloss: v. 警戒 / n. 守衛者

examples.en: You should wash your hands before eating to guard against disease.
examples.zh: 你飯前應洗手，以防生病。

examples.en: Guava juice as well as orange juice is rich in vitamin C.
examples.zh: 番石榴汁和柳橙汁一樣富含維他命 C。

examples.en: The motel manager showed the guests to their room.
examples.zh: 汽車旅館經理把旅客領到他們房間。

examples.en: Martin guided him to the reception-room.
examples.zh: 馬丁將他領到接待室。

examples.en: He taught Mary how to shoot a gun.
examples.zh: 他教瑪麗如何射擊。

examples.en: He works out at the gym as often as he can.
examples.zh: 他儘可能多上健身房健身。

examples.en: Everyone laughed when they saw my haircut.
examples.zh: 看到我的髮型，大家都大笑。

examples.en: Leave your umbrella in the hall.
examples.zh: 把雨傘放在門廳內。

examples.en: Hamburgers and fries are typical American fast food.
examples.zh: 漢堡和薯條是典型的美式速食。

words.gloss: v. 對付 / n. 柄；把手

examples.en: I didn't know how to handle these people.
examples.zh: 我不知道如何對付這些人。

examples.en: He looked handsome and healthy.
examples.zh: 他看上去英俊而健康。

examples.en: My legs were so weak that I could hardly stand.
examples.zh: 我的腿虛弱得簡直無法站立。

examples.en: He identifies with the hero of a novel.
examples.zh: 他把自己設想成一部小說中的主人翁。

examples.en: They are highly skilled workers.
examples.zh: 他們是技術很好的工人。

examples.en: Ebola fever is a highly infectious disease.
examples.zh: 伊波拉熱是高度傳染性疾病。

examples.en: Gambling opened up the highway to hopelessness for him.
examples.zh: 賭博使他走上了絕望的道路。

examples.en: The boy scouts hiked out to the forest.
examples.zh: 童子軍步行去森林。

examples.en: He stood there with his hands on his hips.
examples.zh: 他站在那兒，兩手叉腰。

examples.en: I love to see the hippopotamus in the zoo.
examples.zh: 我愛看動物園裡的河馬。

examples.en: Dr. Brown is a famous scholar on historical research.
examples.zh: 布朗博士是史學研究方面著名的學者。

examples.en: He looked into the room through the key hole.
examples.zh: 他從鑰匙洞偷窺室內。

examples.en: The frog hopped along the shore of the pond.
examples.zh: 那隻青蛙沿著池塘邊跳躍。

examples.en: Yesterday we were hosts to a few friends.
examples.zh: 昨天我們接待了幾位朋友。

examples.en: She spent a huge amount of money on that coat.
examples.zh: 她花了大筆的錢買那件衣服。

examples.en: This meat is not fit for human beings.
examples.zh: 這種肉不適合人食用。

examples.en: Many famous people are surprisingly humble.
examples.zh: 許多知名人士都出奇地謙恭。

examples.en: November is a good time to hunt deer.
examples.zh: 十一月正是獵鹿的好時節。

examples.en: David was a very brave young hunter.
examples.zh: 大衛是個非常勇敢的年輕獵手。

words.gloss: n. 匆忙 / v. 急促

examples.en: The salesman hurried the customer to make a choice.
examples.zh: 售貨員催促顧客作出選擇。

words.gloss: adj. 理想的 / n. 理想

examples.en: I need advice on how to reach my ideal weight.
examples.zh: 我需要建議教我如何達到理想體重。

examples.en: Our principal has high ideals.
examples.zh: 我們校長有崇高理想。

examples.en: The officer asked me to provide my identity card.
examples.zh: 警官要求我出示身分證。

examples.en: A photo ID is an identity document that includes a photograph of the holder.
examples.zh: 有照片的身分證明文件上會有持有人的照片。

examples.en: His letters were ignored.
examples.zh: 他的信無人理會。

examples.en: Mary's son is ill today.
examples.zh: 瑪麗的兒子今天病了。

examples.en: How can we improve our image?
examples.zh: 我們要如何改進我們的形象？

examples.en: She peered closely at her image in the mirror.
examples.zh: 她凝視鏡中影像。

examples.en: I can't imagine what has happened.
examples.zh: 我想像不出發生了什麼事。

examples.en: Here, I would stress the importance of mathematics to the whole of science.
examples.zh: 這裡我要強調數學對整個科學的重要性。

examples.en: That was an impressive performance from such a young tennis player.
examples.zh: 這麼年輕的選手有此表現是很令人印象深刻的。

examples.en: He put forward a plan for improving the rate of production.
examples.zh: 他提出了一個提高生產率的計劃。

examples.en: The price includes both house and furniture.
examples.zh: 價錢包括房子和傢俱。

examples.en: Tony lives beyond his income.
examples.zh: 湯尼的花費超出其收入。

words.gloss: v. 增加 / n. 增進

examples.en: Travel increases one's knowledge of the world.
examples.zh: 旅遊增進人對世界的了解。

examples.en: 【諺】A friend in need is a friend indeed.
examples.zh: 患難之交才是真正的朋友。

examples.en: India gained independence from Britain in 1947.
examples.zh: 印度於一九四七年脫離英國獲得獨立。

words.gloss: n. 無黨派者 / adj. 獨立的

examples.zh: 非洲許多殖民地在一九五十年代成了獨立國家。
