examples.zh: 電梯上方的燈指示那時電梯在十五樓。

words.gloss: adj. 個別的 / n. 個人

examples.en: Students can apply for individual tuition.
examples.zh: 學生可申請個別授課。

examples.en: Each individual should be respected.
examples.zh: 每一個個體都應該被尊重。

examples.en: Our automobile industry is expanding.
examples.zh: 我們的汽車工業在發展。

examples.en: The influence of climate on crops is self-evident.
examples.zh: 氣候對農作物的影響是不證自明的。

examples.en: The book was worn out and had ink stains on its cover.
examples.zh: 這本書破舊了，封面上有墨漬。

examples.en: He insisted that his rights (should) be respected.
examples.zh: 他堅持他的權利應該被尊重。

examples.en: Let me give you some instances.
examples.zh: 讓我給你舉幾個例子。

words.gloss: adj. 立即 / n. 瞬間

examples.en: The telegram asked for an instant reply.
examples.zh: 這封電報要求立即回覆。

examples.en: He is too busy; let me go instead.
examples.zh: 他太忙了，讓我去吧。

examples.en: You should study hard instead of lying in bed.
examples.zh: 你應該努力而非躺在床上。

examples.en: She gives instruction in mathematics.
examples.zh: 她講授數學。

examples.en: The dentist picked up several instruments.
examples.zh: 那牙科醫生把幾把器械收拾好。

examples.en: He suffered injuries to several internal organs.
examples.zh: 他好幾個內臟器官受傷。

examples.en: The Minister of Internal Affairs has submitted his resignation.
examples.zh: 內政部長已經遞出辭呈。

examples.en: Several international celebrities were present at the statesman's memorial service.
examples.zh: 幾位國際知名人士出席了此政治家的追悼儀式。

examples.en: We can find all kinds of information on the Internet.
examples.zh: 我們可以在網際網路上找到各種資訊。

examples.en: It was my younger brother who introduced me to jazz.
examples.zh: 是我的弟弟介紹我聽爵士樂的。

examples.en: Should I make the introductions?
examples.zh: 我來介紹一下好嗎？

examples.en: With the introduction of the new drugs, many lives will be saved.
examples.zh: 隨著新藥的推出，許多人因而得救。

words.gloss: n. 鐵；熨斗 / v. 熨燙

examples.en: Can you iron my shirt, please?
examples.zh: 請幫我燙襯衫好嗎？

words.gloss: n. 果醬；堵塞物 / v. 堵塞（jam-jammed-jammed）

examples.en: Thousands of people jammed the stadium.
examples.zh: 成千上萬的人把體育場擠得滿滿的。

examples.en: I felt someone jogging my elbow.
examples.zh: 我發覺有人推我的胳膊肘。

examples.en: He suffers from arthritis in his leg joints.
examples.zh: 他的腿關節遭受關節炎之苦。

examples.en: Father keeps a journal of his activities.
examples.zh: 我父親每天記錄他的生活。

words.gloss: n. 法官 / v. 裁判

examples.en: Who will judge the case?
examples.zh: 誰將審判這個案子？

examples.en: All men should be treated with justice.
examples.zh: 人人都應受到公平待遇。

examples.en: Justice has been done.
examples.zh: 正義得到了伸張。

examples.en: The zoo keeper is feeding the animals.
examples.zh: 動物園飼養人在餵動物。

examples.en: Children like to put a lot of ketchup on the French fries.
examples.zh: 小孩子喜歡在薯條上加許多蕃茄醬。

examples.en: The largest brain possessed by any dinosaur weighed about a kilogram.
examples.zh: 最大的恐龍腦子大約有一公斤重。

examples.en: I don't seem to lack anything.
examples.zh: 我好像什麼也不缺。

examples.en: "A lady wants to see you, sir."
examples.zh: 「先生，有位女士想見你。」

examples.en: A ladybug is called a ladybird, too.
examples.zh: 瓢蟲又稱為 ladybird。

examples.en: Which do you prefer, lamb chops or pork chops?
examples.zh: 你比較喜歡小羊排，還是豬排？

examples.en: A carriage drove down the muddy lane.
examples.zh: 一輛馬車沿著泥濘的小路行駛。

examples.en: Lantern Festival comes soon after the Chinese New Year.
examples.zh: 元宵節緊接著中國新年來臨。

examples.en: Mother holds the baby in/on her lap.
examples.zh: 母親將嬰兒抱在膝上。

words.gloss: adj. 最新的；最近的 / n. 最新的事物

examples.en: The model is dressed in the latest Paris fashion.
examples.zh: 模特兒身穿巴黎最新款式的時裝。

words.gloss: adj. 後面的 / n. 後者

examples.en: This latter point was of great importance.
examples.zh: 後面這點極為重要。

examples.en: Where unemployment and crime are high, it can be assumed that the latter is due to the former.
examples.zh: 當失業率和犯罪率呈現雙高，一般認為後者歸因於前者。

examples.en: That is against the law.
examples.zh: 那是違反法律的。

examples.en: The hen laid some eggs.
examples.zh: 母雞下了蛋。

examples.en: The vice-president took over the leadership of the country.
examples.zh: 副總統接掌了國家領導權。

examples.en: The trees are thick with leaves.
examples.zh: 這些樹生長著濃密的樹葉。

examples.en: Gambling is not legal here.
examples.zh: 這裡賭博是不合法的。

examples.en: Could you lend me your dictionary?
examples.zh: 你能把字典借給我嗎？

examples.en: The fish is two feet in length.
examples.zh: 這條魚有兩英尺長。

examples.en: He wore contact lenses instead of regular glasses.
examples.zh: 他戴隱形眼鏡而不是一般的眼鏡。

words.gloss: adj. 開明的；心胸寬闊的

examples.en: The headmaster has liberal views about what his pupils should wear.
examples.zh: 校長對學生服裝持開明態度。

examples.en: Put the lid on the box.
examples.zh: 把箱子的蓋子蓋上。

examples.en: This box is too heavy for me to lift.
examples.zh: 這個箱子太重了，我提不起來。

examples.en: John is likely to be in London this autumn.
examples.zh: 今年秋天約翰可能在倫敦。

words.gloss: n. 限制；界限 / v. 限制

examples.en: That fence is the limit of the schoolyard.
examples.zh: 那堵圍牆是校園的界限。

words.gloss: n. 連結；環 / v. 連結

examples.en: That is the only weak link in his reasoning.
examples.zh: 那是他推理中唯一的薄弱環節。

examples.en: Oil, milk and water are all liquids.
examples.zh: 油、牛奶和水都是液體。

examples.en: If you've got any problems, she's a good listener.
examples.zh: 要是你有什麼煩心的事，她會耐心聽你傾訴。

examples.en: Alcohol may cause damage to the liver.
examples.zh: 酒精會損壞肝臟。

words.gloss: n. 裝載；負荷 / v. 裝貨

examples.en: The maximum load for this elevator is eight persons.
examples.zh: 這個電梯最大的載重量是八個人。

examples.en: The worker loaded the truck with furniture.
examples.zh: 工人把家具裝載上卡車。

examples.en: He works at the local post office.
examples.zh: 他在本地的郵局工作。

examples.en: In that cloudy sky only one lone star could be seen.
examples.zh: 在那多雲的天上，只能看到孤零零的一顆星星。

examples.en: He suffered a temporary loss of memory.
examples.zh: 他暫時喪失了記憶。

words.gloss: adj. 較低的 / v. 降下；放低

examples.en: He belongs to the lower middle class.
examples.zh: 他來自中產階級下層。

examples.en: He lowered a bucket into the well to get some water.
examples.zh: 他將水桶放下井去取些水。

examples.en: It's a matter of luck whether we are successful.
examples.zh: 我們是否成功是碰運氣的事。

examples.en: He writes short stories for a monthly magazine.
examples.zh: 他為一家月刊雜誌撰寫短篇小說。

examples.en: Ann and Mary maintained their friendship for the next thirty years.
examples.zh: 安與瑪麗在此後的三十年中一直保持著她們之間的友誼。

words.gloss: adj. 主要的 / v. 主修 / n. 主修科目

examples.en: The house needs major repairs.
examples.zh: 這幢房子需要大修。

examples.en: He majors in French.
examples.zh: 他主修法語。

examples.en: Her major is history.
examples.zh: 他主修歷史。

words.gloss: v. 管理；經營；設法做到

examples.en: He manages a hotel for his father.
examples.zh: 他替他父親經營一家旅館。

examples.en: They managed to hand in the report on time.
examples.zh: 他們設法準時繳交報告。

examples.en: The work has been divided into smaller, more manageable sections.
examples.zh: 工作已分成幾個少量易管理的部分。

examples.en: He is a store manager.
examples.zh: 他是一位商店的經理。

words.gloss: n. 男人；雄性動物 / adj. 男性的；雄的

examples.en: A male nurse took my temperature.
examples.zh: 一位男護理師給我量了體溫。

examples.en: There was a mango fever in Taiwan last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天台灣流行吃芒果。

examples.en: We walked in a leisurely manner, looking in all the windows.
examples.zh: 我們慢悠悠地走著，看遍所有的櫥窗。

examples.en: It is bad manners to interrupt.
examples.zh: 打斷別人的話是不禮貌的。

examples.en: They broke up after five years of marriage.
examples.zh: 他們結婚五年後離婚了。

examples.en: He is going to marry Jane.
examples.zh: 他將與珍結婚。

examples.en: All guests wore masks to the ball.
examples.zh: 所有客人都戴假面具參加舞會。

words.gloss: adj. 大量的 / n. 大量；彌撒

examples.en: I have masses of work to do.
examples.zh: 我有許許多多的工作要做。

examples.en: The dog ran to its master.
examples.zh: 那狗向它主人跑去。

examples.en: He spread a mat on the floor.
examples.zh: 他在地板上鋪上一張蓆子。

words.gloss: n. 比賽；對手；火柴；相配的物品/一對 / v. 和…相配

examples.en: Our side beat the other in the match.
examples.zh: 我方在競賽中擊敗了對方。

examples.en: Does this shirt match these trousers?
examples.zh: 這件襯衫跟這條褲子相配嗎？

examples.en: He found himself separated from his mates.
examples.zh: 他發現自己與夥伴們分開了。

examples.en: Wood and stone are the only raw materials on the island.
examples.zh: 木材和石頭是這個島上僅有的原料。

examples.en: I had a solid meal.
examples.zh: 我飽食了一頓。

examples.en: This is the most mature of his plays.
examples.zh: 這是他最成熟的一部劇作。

examples.en: I don't understand the meaning of that paragraph.
examples.zh: 我不懂那段話的意思。

examples.en: It is all a means to an end.
examples.zh: 這只是達到目的的一種手段。

words.gloss: n. 尺寸；量度標準 / v. 度量

examples.en: We measured the distance.
examples.zh: 我們測量了距離。

examples.en: Why did the patient refuse to take the medicine?
examples.zh: 那個病人為什麼不肯服藥？

examples.en: Mr. White isn't here; he's at a meeting.
examples.zh: 懷特先生不在這兒，他在開會。

examples.en: He played an old Irish melody.
examples.zh: 他演奏了一支古老的愛爾蘭曲。

words.gloss: n. 會員身份(或地位、資格)

examples.en: You have to apply for membership in the club.
examples.zh: 你需申請俱樂部的會員身份。

examples.en: His phone number has slipped my memory.
examples.zh: 他的電話號碼我記不起來了。

examples.en: The weather here is wonderful, not to mention the beautiful scenery.
examples.zh: 這裡天氣好極了，更別提美麗的風景。

examples.en: Don't mention it.
examples.zh: 別客氣。

examples.en: We've just received a congratulatory message from them.
examples.zh: 我們剛剛收到他們的賀電。

examples.en: Heat expands metal.
examples.zh: 熱使金屬膨脹。

examples.en: The blue whale grows to over 30 meters long.
examples.zh: 藍鯨可以長到三十多米長。

examples.en: A new training method was introduced.
examples.zh: 引進了一種新的訓練方法。

examples.en: Kissing at midnight on New Year's Eve is a long held tradition.
examples.zh: 跨年夜在午夜接吻是一種長期存在的傳統。

examples.en: At first we covered about 100 miles a day.
examples.zh: 起初我們每天行一百英里。

words.gloss: adj. 軍事的 / n. 軍隊；陸軍

examples.en: There used to be a military base in the region.
examples.zh: 這地區過去有個軍事基地。

examples.en: The military took over the government.
examples.zh: 軍方接管了政府。

words.gloss: adj. 較小的；較少的；次要的 / n. 未成年者；副修科目 / v. 副修

examples.en: I have made some minor changes to the paper.
examples.zh: 我把論文做了些微的改變。

examples.en: The young actress was given a minor role.
examples.zh: 年輕女演員被分配到一個小角色。

examples.en: This film contains material unsuitable for minors.
examples.zh: 這部電影帶有未成年者不宜的內容。

examples.en: I'm taking history as my minor.
examples.zh: 我副修歷史。

examples.en: She majored in physics and minored in political science.
examples.zh: 她主修物理，副修政治學。

examples.en: Only a minority of the class voted for the plan.
examples.zh: 班裡只有少數學生投票贊成這項計劃。

examples.en: minority groups
examples.zh: 少數群體

words.gloss: n. 鏡子 / v. 反映出…

examples.en: The motorist saw in his driving mirror that a police car was following him.
examples.zh: 那位駕駛從後視鏡裡看到一輛警車正跟著他。

words.gloss: v. 混合 / n. 混合物

examples.en: The cook mixed the egg with the flour.
examples.zh: 廚師將蛋與麵粉混合。

examples.en: The talk was conducted in a mixture of English, Russian and French.
examples.zh: 會談是以英、俄、法文混雜進行的。

examples.en: He made a clay model of the Eiffel Tower.
examples.zh: 他做了一個艾菲爾鐵塔的黏土模型。

examples.en: I am not in the mood to argue.
examples.zh: 我沒有心情爭辯。

examples.en: Mops for cleaning the floor have a long handle.
examples.zh: 擦洗地板的拖把有一個長柄。

examples.en: All her motions were graceful.
examples.zh: 她的一舉一動都很優美。

examples.en: He rides a motorcycle to work every day.
examples.zh: 他每天騎摩托車去上班。

examples.en: He drank a mug of coffee.
examples.zh: 他喝了一大馬克杯咖啡。

words.gloss: adj. 音樂的 / n. 音樂劇

examples.en: She can play several musical instruments.
examples.zh: 她會演奏多種樂器。

examples.en: She appeared in several Broadway musicals.
examples.zh: 她在好幾齣百老匯音樂劇中演出過。

examples.en: An orchestra of 12 musicians will perform in the city hall next week.
examples.zh: 一個十二人管弦樂隊將於下週在市政廳演奏。

words.gloss: n. 釘子；指甲 / v. 釘

examples.en: The nail has been pulled out.
examples.zh: 那支釘子拔出來了。

words.gloss: adj. 狹窄的 / v. 使變狹窄

examples.en: The street is too narrow for a truck.
examples.zh: 這條街太窄，卡車無法行駛。

examples.en: The whole nation is overjoyed.
examples.zh: 舉國歡騰。

examples.en: Cats have a natural fear of water.
examples.zh: 貓天生厭水。

examples.en: You ought to be stricter with him. He's very naughty.
examples.zh: 你該對他更嚴格一些。他很調皮。

examples.en: The cinema nearby can seat 1,000 people.
examples.zh: 附近那家電影院可容納一千名觀眾。

examples.en: She is nearly fifty now.
examples.zh: 她將近五十歲了。

examples.en: He keeps his desk neat.
examples.zh: 他保持書桌整潔。

examples.en: It is necessary that he be sent there at once.
examples.zh: 有必要馬上派他到那裡去。

examples.en: Mrs. Lee wore a necklace of silver, glass and amber.
examples.zh: 李太太戴著一條用銀、玻璃和琥珀做成的項鍊。

examples.en: The needle of the compass shows that we're facing south.
examples.zh: 指南針上的磁針顯示我們處在朝南的位置。

words.gloss: adj. 否定的；負面的 / n. 消極的

examples.en: He gave me a negative answer.
examples.zh: 他給了我一個否定的答案。

examples.en: Canada and the United States are neighbors.
examples.zh: 加拿大和美國是鄰邦。

examples.en: Neither shoe fits comfortably.
examples.zh: 兩隻鞋都不合腳。

examples.en: My nephew will go to college this year.
examples.zh: 我姪子今年要上大學。

examples.en: That music gets on my nerves.
examples.zh: 音樂讓我心煩。

examples.en: He doesn't have the nerve to propose to her.
examples.zh: 他沒勇氣向她求婚。

words.gloss: adj. 神經質的；緊張不安的

examples.en: We were nervous about the recent report of local violence.
examples.zh: 我們對於最近本地暴力事件的報導感到緊張。

examples.en: They have developed marketing networks.
examples.zh: 他們已經形成了銷售網絡。

examples.en: My niece is a tall and beautiful girl.
examples.zh: 我姪女是個高挑美女。

examples.en: She nodded to me in a friendly fashion.
examples.zh: 她友好地向我點了點頭。

words.gloss: pron. 全無 / adv. 一點也不

examples.en: He had none of his brother's boldness.
examples.zh: 他一點都不像他哥哥那樣有魄力。

examples.en: We ate beef noodles for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們中午吃牛肉麵。

examples.en: I have neither time nor money for pop festivals.
examples.zh: 我既沒時間也沒錢來參加流行音樂節。

examples.en: The city is in the northern end of the bridge.
examples.zh: 這個城市位於橋的北端。

examples.en: I've jotted down all the new words I've learned in a notebook.
examples.zh: 我把我學的新詞全都記在一個筆記本上了。

words.gloss: n. 小說 / adj. 新穎的

examples.en: He has written several novels.
examples.zh: 他寫過好幾部小說。

examples.en: We can crack nuts in the nutcrackers.
examples.zh: 我們可以把堅果放在胡桃鉗裡軋碎。

examples.en: Obey your boss or you will be fired.
examples.zh: 服從上司，否則你會被解雇。

words.gloss: n. 物體；目標 / v. 反對

examples.en: I don't know the names of the objects in this lab.
examples.zh: 我不知道這個實驗室裡物件的名稱。

examples.en: No one objected to the plan.
examples.zh: 沒有人反對這項計畫。

examples.en: It was quite obvious that she was not going home.
examples.zh: 很顯然她不打算回家。

examples.en: Earthquakes occur frequently in this area.
examples.zh: 這一地區經常發生地震。

examples.en: Humans may be able to live in the depths of the ocean someday.
examples.zh: 有朝一日人類也許能在海洋深處生活。

examples.en: We offered him the calculator for US$50.
examples.zh: 這計算機我們向他開價五十美元。

words.gloss: n. 官員；公務員 / adj. 官方的；正式的

examples.en: The President's official duties include being Commander in Chief.
examples.zh: 總統的職責包括擔任總司令。

examples.en: The machine is not operating properly.
examples.zh: 機器運轉得不正常。

examples.en: Dial "0" to get the operator.
examples.zh: 撥 0 接總機。

examples.en: Untrained operators cannot use these machines.
examples.zh: 未經訓練的操作員無法使用這些機器。

examples.en: Opinions differ on this matter.
examples.zh: 對這件事各人看法不一。

examples.en: She put on an ordinary dress.
examples.zh: 她穿著平常的洋裝。

examples.en: The heart is one of the body's vital organs.
examples.zh: 心臟是人體重要器官。

examples.en: A court is an organ of government.
examples.zh: 法庭是一個政府機構。

examples.en: It is a non-profit organization.
examples.zh: 這是一個非營利性的組織。

examples.en: What was the origin of the quarrel?
examples.zh: 這場爭吵的起因是什麼？

examples.en: The president's family was of humble origins.
examples.zh: 總統出身貧寒。

examples.en: Who is the owner of that motorcycle?
examples.zh: 誰是那輛摩托車的主人？

examples.en: The death of her son gave her infinite pain.
examples.zh: 她兒子的去世使她悲痛欲絕。

examples.en: My back is so painful that I cannot stand upright anymore.
examples.zh: 我的背疼痛難忍，我現在甚至站不直了。

examples.en: The house was considerably out of repair and badly in need of painting.
examples.zh: 這房子嚴重失修，急需上油漆。

examples.en: He just got up and was still in pajamas.
examples.zh: 他剛剛起床，還穿著睡衣。

examples.en: She was pale with fear.
examples.zh: 她嚇得臉色發白。

examples.en: He cooked the pasta in a large pan of boiling water.
examples.zh: 他用一大鍋開水煮義大利麵食。

examples.en: Pandas are adorable animals.
examples.zh: 貓熊是很可愛的動物。

examples.en: Papaya milk is very nutritious.
examples.zh: 木瓜牛奶很營養。

words.gloss: n. 原諒 / v. 赦免

examples.en: I beg your pardon. I suppose I should have knocked.
examples.zh: 請原諒。我想我應該先敲一下門的。

examples.en: No professionals participated in the contest.
examples.zh: 沒有職業選手參加這一比賽。

examples.en: The teacher showed particular concern for the disabled child.
examples.zh: 老師特別關心那個殘疾兒童。

examples.en: They were partners in crime.
examples.zh: 他倆是同謀犯。

examples.en: You can't gain access to the computer system without entering your password.
examples.zh: 沒有輸入密碼，你無法使用電腦。

examples.en: He stuck the sheets of paper together with paste.
examples.zh: 他用漿糊把這些紙張黏在一起。

examples.en: Mix the butter and flour into a paste.
examples.zh: 將奶油和麵粉合成麵糰。

examples.en: They walked along the path through the woods.
examples.zh: 他們沿著林間小路走去。

words.gloss: adj. 有耐心的 / n. 病人

examples.en: He's a very patient man.
examples.zh: 他是個很有耐心的人。

examples.en: The patient lost consciousness.
examples.zh: 病人失去了知覺。

examples.en: I don't like the pattern on the fabric.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡那塊布料上的圖案。

examples.en: We live in peace with our neighbors.
examples.zh: 我們與鄰居和睦相處。

words.gloss: adj. 和平的；愛好和平的；安祥寧靜的

examples.en: I enjoy taking a walk in a peaceful garden.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在寧靜的花園裡散步。

examples.en: Frank's mom can make delicious peach pie.
examples.zh: Frank 的媽媽會做好吃的桃子派。

examples.en: The mountain peak was covered with snow.
examples.zh: 山頂被雪覆蓋著。

examples.en: Hotel rooms are hard to find in the peak season.
examples.zh: 旺季很難訂得到旅館。

examples.en: Pears are a sweet and juicy fruit.
examples.zh: 梨子是一種甜而多汁的水果。

examples.en: Admission is NT$100 per person.
examples.zh: 入場費每人新台幣一百元。

words.gloss: adj. 完美的 / v. 使完美

examples.en: Her acting is really perfect.
examples.zh: 她的演技真到了爐火純青的境界。

examples.en: She went to France to perfect her French.
examples.zh: 她為了使法語精進而去法國。

examples.en: Many decisions need to be made in a very short period of time.
examples.zh: 有許多決定需要在很短的時間內做出。

examples.en: A period is used to signal the end of a complete sentence.
examples.zh: 句點用於表示完整句子的結尾。

examples.en: It's all a matter of personal taste.
examples.zh: 這純粹是個人的興趣問題。

words.gloss: n. 人格；個性；(電視)名人

examples.en: Everyone is attracted to her for her pleasant personality.
examples.zh: 每個人都被她愉快的人格特質所吸引。

examples.en: The show is hosted by a popular TV personality.
examples.zh: 這個節目由一個受歡迎的電視明星主持。

examples.en: Try to learn these English words and phrases by heart.
examples.zh: 努力把這些英語單字和片語記住。

examples.en: In bed, I rest my head on a soft pillow filled with feathers.
examples.zh: 在床上，我把頭擱在用羽毛作為枕心的軟枕頭上。

examples.en: You can put a lot of different pizza toppings on a pizza base.
examples.zh: 你可以在比薩餅皮上放許多不同的餡料。

words.gloss: n. 平原；草原 / adj. 明白的；樸素的

examples.en: The hermit advocates plain living.
examples.zh: 這位隱士提倡過簡樸的生活。

examples.en: He was coming by train, so I waited on the platform.
examples.zh: 他坐火車來，所以我在月臺上等。

words.gloss: n. (學校的)操場；(兒童)遊樂場

examples.en: You can find him on the playground.
examples.zh: 你去操場能找到他。

words.gloss: adj. 愉快的；討人喜歡的

examples.en: The walk was very pleasant.
examples.zh: 那次散步很愉快。

words.gloss: prep. 加 / adj. 正的 / n. 加號；有利之處

examples.en: Five plus two equals seven.
examples.zh: 五加二等於七。

examples.en: The poet will recite some of her recent poems.
examples.zh: 詩人將會朗誦幾首她最近寫的詩。

examples.en: Alfred Lord Tennyson was one of the most famous Poet Laureates.
examples.zh: 但尼生伯爵是最有名的桂冠詩人之一。

examples.en: He was very fond of writing and reciting poetry.
examples.zh: 他很喜歡寫詩、背詩。

words.gloss: n. 毒物；毒藥 / v. 下毒

examples.en: Gas is a poison.
examples.zh: 煤氣是有毒氣體。

examples.en: He poisoned his wife.
examples.zh: 他毒死了他的太太。

examples.en: I don't much enjoy policemen and robbers films.
examples.zh: 我不很喜歡警匪片。

examples.en: Honesty is the best policy.
examples.zh: 誠實是上策。

words.gloss: v. 發出砰啪響聲；突然出現 / adj. 通俗的；流行的

examples.en: The bottle popped when I opened it.
examples.zh: 我打開瓶子時，瓶口發出砰的一聲。

examples.en: When I opened the box, a clown pops out.
examples.zh: 我打開盒子，一個小丑跳出來。

examples.en: Pop music is popular with teenagers because it consists of a strong beat and simple tunes that are easy to remember.
examples.zh: 流行音樂因節拍明顯、旋律易記，而受青少年歡迎。

examples.en: The population of this country rose by 10 percent.
examples.zh: 這個國家的人口增長了百分之十。

examples.en: Sweet and sour pork chops is one of my favorite dishes.
examples.zh: 糖醋排骨是我最喜歡的菜之一。

examples.en: We must reach port by evening.
examples.zh: 我們必須在傍晚前抵港。

words.gloss: n. 姿勢 / v. 擺姿勢

examples.en: "Hold that pose," said the photographer.
examples.zh: 「保持那個姿勢別動。」攝影師說。

examples.en: The family posed outside the house.
examples.zh: 全家人在屋外擺好姿勢準備拍照。

examples.en: He has a high position in society.
examples.zh: 他社會地位很高。

examples.en: Are you positive that you saw him?
examples.zh: 你肯定你看到他嗎？

examples.en: There is a good possibility of rain tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚很可能要下雨。

examples.en: The last post had arrived, but there was no letter for her.
examples.zh: 最後一批郵件已到，但沒有她的信。

examples.en: He sent me a postcard from the United Nations.
examples.zh: 他從聯合國給我寄來一張明信片。

examples.en: The potato weighs 4 pounds.
examples.zh: 這馬鈴薯有四磅重。

examples.en: He had broad shoulders and powerful arms.
examples.zh: 他肩膀寬大，雙臂有力。

examples.en: The publishers praised his novel pretty highly.
examples.zh: 出版商們對他的小說評價甚高。

examples.en: The athletic meet is on Saturday, so we're praying for a fine day.
examples.zh: 學校的運動會是星期六，所以我們虔心祈求好天氣。

examples.en: She knelt to say a prayer of deep thankfulness.
examples.zh: 她跪著禱告表達深深的感恩。

examples.en: She preferred the quiet countryside to the noisy cities.
examples.zh: 相較於喧鬧的城市，她較喜歡安靜的鄉村。

examples.en: The president of France visited our country last week.
examples.zh: 上週法國總統訪問了我國。

words.gloss: v. 按壓 / n. 印刷機；新聞界；出版社

examples.en: Press this button to start the engine.
examples.zh: 按此鈕發動引擎。

examples.en: He denied that he had leaked the news to the press.
examples.zh: 他否認曾將這消息洩漏給新聞界。

words.gloss: n. 壓力 / v. 施壓

examples.en: Most students are under pressure to perform well on exams.
examples.zh: 大部分學生都承受著得考高分的壓力。

examples.en: Don't feel we are pressuring you to do what you don't want to do.
examples.zh: 不要以為我們在逼你做你不想做的事。

examples.en: He looked at his painting with pride.
examples.zh: 他得意地看著他的畫。

examples.en: Lady Diana Spencer became Princess Diana when she married Prince Charles.
examples.zh: 黛安娜小姐嫁給查理王子成為王妃。

examples.en: Princess Mermaid (The Little Mermaid) was a famous fairy tale written by Hans Christian Andersen.
examples.zh: 人魚公主是安徒生所寫的著名的童話故事。

words.gloss: n. 教士；神父；牧師(尤指羅馬天主教、東正教、英國國教)

examples.en: The priest conducts the church service.
examples.zh: 牧師主持教堂的禮拜儀式。

examples.en: A primary cause of Tom's failure is his laziness.
examples.zh: 湯姆失敗的主要原因之一是懶惰。

words.gloss: adj. 主要的 / n. 校長

examples.en: Drinking is a principal cause of traffic accidents.
examples.zh: 酗酒是交通事故的主要原因。

examples.en: The school principal read the honor roll list.
examples.zh: 校長宣讀優秀生名單。

examples.en: I take this seriously. It's a matter of principle.
examples.zh: 我對此很認真。這是原則問題。

examples.en: The book was printed on rough yellow paper.
examples.zh: 這本書用粗糙的黃紙印刷。

examples.en: The laser printer cost me five thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 這台雷射印表機花了我五千元。

examples.en: Her father is in prison.
examples.zh: 她的父親在坐牢。

examples.en: We might get taken prisoner by the enemy.
examples.zh: 我們有可能被敵人俘虜。

words.gloss: adj. 私人的；秘密的；私立的

examples.en: I wish to have a private talk with you.
examples.zh: 我希望私下和你談談。

examples.en: His poem won the first prize in the contest.
examples.zh: 他的詩作在比賽中獲得第一名。

words.gloss: v. 生產 / n. 農產品

examples.en: His arrival produced a sensation.
examples.zh: 他的抵達引起轟動。

examples.en: The place is known for its dairy produce.
examples.zh: 此地產乳品聞名。

words.gloss: n. 製造；(戲/影片/專輯)作品

examples.en: The latest car will be in production by the end of the year.
examples.zh: 最新款的汽車將在年底開始製造。

examples.en: Disney's latest production (= film) looks likely to be their most successful ever.
examples.zh: 迪士尼的最新作品看來會是他們最成功的一部。

examples.en: He has made great progress this year.
examples.zh: 他今年進步很多。

examples.en: The work progressed at a slow pace.
examples.zh: 工作進展緩慢。

words.gloss: n. 計畫；設計 / v. 投出；計劃

examples.en: Their project collapsed for lack of money.
examples.zh: 他們的計畫因資金短缺而告失敗。

examples.en: The government projected a tax decrease.
examples.zh: 政府計劃減稅。

words.gloss: n. 諾言 / v. 允諾

examples.en: I can't give you the book; I've promised it to Susan.
examples.zh: 我不能把這本書給你，我已經答應給蘇珊了。

examples.en: It's not proper for me to give you that information.
examples.zh: 我把資料給你不太恰當。

examples.en: Try to eat proper meals instead of fast food.
examples.zh: 儘量吃適宜的的餐食而不要吃速食。

examples.en: It was proposed that we go to the station to meet our guests.
examples.zh: 有人建議我們去車站接客人。

examples.en: May God protect you from harm.
examples.zh: 願上帝保佑你免受傷害。

examples.en: Motorcyclists must wear protective helmets.
examples.zh: 機車騎士必須頭戴安全帽。

examples.en: On Sundays, his landlady provides dinner as well as breakfast.
examples.zh: 星期天，他的女房東不但供早餐，還供晚餐。

examples.en: I'll prove to the world that he was right.
examples.zh: 我將向世人證明他是對的。

examples.en: Rice pudding is nourishing.
examples.zh: 米布丁富含營養。

examples.en: The Fairy Godmother turned a pumpkin into a carriage for Cinderella.
examples.zh: 神仙教母將南瓜變成馬車給灰姑娘乘坐。

examples.en: Motorists should be severely punished for speeding.
examples.zh: 超速駕車的人應受嚴厲懲罰。

examples.en: The school has 1500 pupils.
examples.zh: 這所學校有一千五百名小學生。

words.gloss: n. 偶；傀儡；受操縱的人

examples.en: Are we the puppets of fate?
examples.zh: 我們都受命運的擺佈嗎？

examples.en: His dog had a litter of puppies.
examples.zh: 他的狗生了一窩小狗。

words.gloss: n. 紫色 / adj. 紫的

examples.en: His face turned purple with rage.
examples.zh: 他氣得臉色發紫。

examples.en: What is the purpose of his visit?
examples.zh: 他來訪的目的是什麼？

words.gloss: v. 使困惑 / n. 困惑；謎

examples.en: What puzzles me is why they didn't show up.
examples.zh: 令我百思不解的是他們為什麼沒有出現。

examples.en: Quality often matters more than quantity.
examples.zh: 質量往往比數量更重要。

examples.en: Mathematics is the science of pure quantity.
examples.zh: 數學是研究純量之科學。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a quiz in English.
examples.zh: 老師給我們測驗英文。

examples.en: We are going to meet at the Taipei Railroad Station.
examples.zh: 我們將在台北火車站見面。

examples.en: New York's Grand Central Terminal is repeatedly named as the most beautiful railway station.
examples.zh: 紐約的中央車站數度被評為最美麗的火車站。

words.gloss: n. 排；一系列；範圍 / v. 漫遊；排列；分布於某範圍

examples.en: The library has ranges of books in perfect order.
examples.zh: 這個圖書館的書一排一排放得井井有條。

examples.en: We ranged the woods looking for a place to set up our tents.
examples.zh: 我們在樹林裡東走西跑，找個地方搭帳篷。

examples.en: He had a rapid recovery from his illness.
examples.zh: 他迅速恢復了健康。

examples.en: These flowers are very rare in this country.
examples.zh: 這些花在該國很少見。

examples.en: I had a rare beef steak.
examples.zh: 我吃了一塊三分熟的牛排。

examples.en: Rats carry very nasty diseases.
examples.zh: 老鼠傳播討厭的疾病。

examples.en: He would rather play than work.
examples.zh: 他寧可玩，卻不願工作。

examples.en: He is out of touch with reality.
examples.zh: 他脫離現實。

examples.en: I realized what he meant.
examples.zh: 我明白了他的意思。

examples.en: I've just received an e-mail.
examples.zh: 我剛收到一份電子郵件。

examples.en: This is a recent period in history.
examples.zh: 這是歷史上近代的一段時期。

words.gloss: n. 記錄；唱片 / adj. 創紀錄的 / v. 做記錄

examples.en: The project was completed in record time.
examples.zh: 工程在從未有過的短時間內完成了。

examples.en: My voice does not record well.
examples.zh: 我的聲音錄下來不好聽。

examples.en: It took him two weeks to recover from his cold.
examples.zh: 他感冒兩星期才恢復健康。

examples.en: The police have recovered the lost jewels.
examples.zh: 警方已經找回丟掉的首飾。

examples.en: Brody reached into the refrigerator and pulled out a beer.
examples.zh: 布羅迪把手伸進冰箱，拿出一罐啤酒。

examples.en: He refused my offer of help.
examples.zh: 他拒絕了我的幫助。

words.gloss: v. 認為；關心 / n. 尊敬

examples.en: No one showed the least regard for his feelings.
examples.zh: 沒人關心他的感受。

examples.en: I regard reading as a recreation.
examples.zh: 我將看書當作一種消遣。

examples.en: I prefer to live in a cold region.
examples.zh: 我寧願住在寒冷的地區。

examples.en: He's got no regular job.
examples.zh: 他沒有固定的工作。

examples.en: The board rejected all our ideas.
examples.zh: 董事會拒絕了我們的所有想法。

examples.en: I don't understand how the two things relate.
examples.zh: 我不明白為何這兩件事有何關聯。

examples.en: He later related the whole story to me.
examples.zh: 他後來把整個故事說給我聽。

examples.en: A good teacher always tries to relate to his students.
examples.zh: 一位好老師總是努力想要懂得學生心理。

examples.en: Their relation seemed quite close.
examples.zh: 他們的關係似乎十分密切。

examples.en: What is your relationship to the victim?
examples.zh: 你是受害者的什麼人？

examples.en: She studied Buddhism and Islam in his religion class.
examples.zh: 她在宗教課上學習佛教和回教。

examples.en: You can use lemon juice to remove the grease.
examples.zh: 你可以用檸檬汁去除油污。

examples.en: I rented an apartment near the school.
examples.zh: 我在學校附近租了間公寓。

examples.en: Rents here are unreasonably high.
examples.zh: 這裡租金貴得不合理。

words.gloss: v. 修理；補救 / n. 修理

examples.en: Nothing can repair the harm you have done.
examples.zh: 你造成的傷害無法彌補。

examples.en: Many of the paintings were beyond repair.
examples.zh: 很多幅畫已經無法修復。

examples.en: He has not yet replied to my question.
examples.zh: 他還沒有回答我的問題。

examples.en: The roof requires repairing.
examples.zh: 屋頂需要修理了。

examples.en: They treated me with respect.
examples.zh: 他們對我很敬重。

examples.en: He didn't respond to my question and just smiled.
examples.zh: 他沒回答我的問題，只是微笑。

words.gloss: adj. 有責任的；負責任的

examples.en: Politicians are responsible to the voters.
examples.zh: 政治家應對選民負責。

examples.en: Can you show me where the restroom is?
examples.zh: 你能告訴我廁所在那裡嗎？

words.gloss: n. 結果；答案 / v. 導致

examples.en: The accident resulted in ten deaths.
examples.zh: 這起事故造成十人死亡。

examples.en: She did not return home till eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 她十一點鐘才回家。

words.gloss: v. 檢閱；檢討 / n. 複習；回顧

examples.en: The President reviewed the fleet.
examples.zh: 總統檢閱了艦隊。

examples.en: We do not see education as merely the road to riches.
examples.zh: 我們不認為教育僅僅是致富之道。

examples.en: She drives carefully up the rocky lane.
examples.zh: 她小心地沿著石頭小巷開去。

examples.en: She played the leading role in the school play.
examples.zh: 她在學校的戲裡扮演主角。

examples.en: The rain's coming. We have to fix the roof.
examples.zh: 雨水進來了。我們得把屋頂修理一下。

examples.en: We kept a rooster and a hen.
examples.zh: 我們養了一隻公雞和母雞。

words.gloss: adj. 極好的 / n. 王室

examples.en: We were treated to a royal feast.
examples.zh: 我們受招待享用豪華宴席。

examples.en: The cat rubbed its back against my leg.
examples.zh: 貓用背擦我的腿。

examples.en: There are a lot of rubber plantations in this area.
examples.zh: 這個地區有許多橡膠園。

examples.en: I did not intend to be rude.
examples.zh: 我並不想粗魯無禮。

examples.en: He is a professional runner.
examples.zh: 他是一個職業的跑者。

examples.en: The children were led to a place of safety.
examples.zh: 孩子們被帶到一個安全的地方。

examples.en: They took a sail to Dover.
examples.zh: 他們乘船去多佛。

examples.en: He had been a sailor in the U.S. navy.
examples.zh: 他曾在美國海軍當水兵。

examples.en: A door-to-door salesperson had been one of the important ways to market products before TV and the Internet existed.
examples.zh: 在電視與網路出現前，挨家挨戶登門推銷的售貨員曾是行銷產品的重要途徑之一。

examples.en: Eating too much salty food is bad for the blood.
examples.zh: 吃太多鹹的食物對血液有害。

examples.en: Our firm gives away free samples of cloth.
examples.zh: 我們公司免費贈送布料樣品。

examples.en: Sand is insoluble in water.
examples.zh: 沙在水中是不溶解的。

examples.en: He ate sandwiches in the office for lunch.
examples.zh: 他在辦公室吃三明治當午餐。

examples.en: That answer won't satisfy her.
examples.zh: 那個回答不能令她滿意。

examples.en: I never saw a saw that saws so well.
examples.zh: 我從沒見過有鋸子鋸得這麼好。

examples.en: You scared me.
examples.zh: 你嚇到我了。

examples.en: It's wrong to think people who are scared of spiders are cowards.
examples.zh: 認為害怕蜘蛛的人就是懦夫是錯誤的。

examples.en: What a fantastic mountain scene!
examples.zh: 多麼迷人的山景！

words.gloss: n. 進度表 / v. 安排

examples.en: Her new book is still well ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 她的新書現在仍然進度超前許多。

examples.en: The meeting is scheduled for 9:00 a.m.
examples.zh: 會議安排在早上九點鐘。

words.gloss: n. 小型摩托車；滑板車

examples.en: Scooters are more fuel-efficient than motorcycles.
examples.zh: 小型摩托車比摩托車更省油。

examples.en: His total score was one hundred and fifty-five.
examples.zh: 他的總積分是一百五十五。

examples.en: He hid behind the screen and overheard their conversation.
examples.zh: 他躲在簾子後面，偷聽到他們的談話。

examples.en: White meat such as poultry, and seafood is healthier than red meat.
examples.zh: 家禽肉和海鮮等白肉比紅肉更健康。

examples.en: He searched every room in the house.
examples.zh: 他搜查了這房子的每一個房間。

examples.en: Enthusiasm is what matters—experience is of secondary importance.
examples.zh: 熱誠最要緊，有沒有經驗倒還其次。

words.gloss: n. 秘密 / adj. 秘密的

examples.en: He kept his illness secret from his parents.
examples.zh: 他沒有告訴他父母他生病的事。

examples.en: Mother cut the cake into six equal sections.
examples.zh: 母親把蛋糕切成相等的六塊。

examples.en: You should seek your lawyer's advice.
examples.zh: 你應該詢問律師的意見。

examples.en: He sought to win her love, but failed.
examples.zh: 他試圖贏得她的芳心，但是失敗了。

examples.en: She seems very happy with the new job.
examples.zh: 她對新工作好像很滿意。

examples.en: I like to play on the seesaw when I was young.
examples.zh: 我小時候喜歡玩蹺蹺板。

examples.en: She seldom showed her feelings.
examples.zh: 她很少表露感情。

examples.en: She was my selection.
examples.zh: 她是我挑選出的人。

examples.en: He selected a team for the special task.
examples.zh: 他為這項特殊任務挑選了一組人馬。

examples.en: She hates her former self.
examples.zh: 她痛恨過去的自己。

examples.en: She is a selfish girl.
examples.zh: 她是個自私自利的女孩。

examples.en: She has no sense of time.
examples.zh: 她沒有時間觀念。

examples.en: He always wears sunglasses because his eyes are sensitive to light.
examples.zh: 他因為對光線敏感所以總是戴著太陽眼鏡。

examples.en: The two communities are separated by a highway.
examples.zh: 這兩個社區由一條公路隔開。

examples.en: The millionaire employs 39 servants.
examples.zh: 這百萬富翁用了三十九個佣人。

examples.en: She served me a cup of coffee.
examples.zh: 她給我端上一杯咖啡。

examples.en: He settled his child in a corner of the compartment.
examples.zh: 他把孩子安頓在車廂的一個角落裡。

examples.en: Jeans are worn by people of both sexes.
examples.zh: 牛仔褲不分性別都有人穿。

examples.en: I feel shame at my rudeness.
examples.zh: 我對我的無禮感到無地自容。

examples.en: It's a shame that you have to leave so soon.
examples.zh: 真可惜你們那麼早就得離開。

examples.en: They were killed by a shark.
examples.zh: 他們被一條鯊魚咬死。

examples.en: My mother changes the sheets every week.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每週換床單。

examples.en: He put the old books on the bottom shelf.
examples.zh: 他將舊書放在底層書架上。

examples.en: The children gathered shells on the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們在海灘上撿貝殼。

examples.en: The sun shone bright and warm.
examples.zh: 陽光燦爛和煦。

examples.en: Your leather shoes need shining.
examples.zh: 你的皮鞋要擦一擦。

words.gloss: v. 使震驚 / n. 震動；衝擊

examples.en: Earthquake shocks are often felt in Japan.
examples.zh: 在日本常常感覺到地震引起的震動。

examples.en: He shot the arrow from the bow.
examples.zh: 他拉弓把箭射了出去。

examples.en: Most shopkeepers in India do not accept credit card payments.
examples.zh: 印度的大多數店主都不接受信用卡付款。

examples.en: The sailor was held up while he was on shore.
examples.zh: 那個水手在岸上遭人搶劫。

examples.en: The policeman fired a warning shot.
examples.zh: 警察鳴槍示警。

examples.en: Please shut up.
examples.zh: 請不要說話。

examples.en: A deer is a shy animal.
examples.zh: 鹿是一種易受驚的動物。

examples.en: In some U.S. states, bicycles are not allowed on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 在美國某些州，人行道上禁止騎自行車。

examples.en: The silence was broken by a loud cry.
examples.zh: 寧靜被一聲喊叫所打破。

examples.en: He was silent for a moment.
examples.zh: 他沈默了一會兒。

examples.en: He told a silly story.
examples.zh: 他講了一個無聊的故事。

examples.en: The ring is made of silver, not gold.
examples.zh: 這戒指是銀的，不是金的。

examples.en: His problem is similar to yours.
examples.zh: 他的問題和你的相似。

examples.en: I simply can't believe it.
examples.zh: 我簡直不能相信這事兒。

examples.en: The child comes from a single parent family.
examples.zh: 這孩子來自單親家庭。

examples.en: He is a writer of great skill.
examples.zh: 他是位寫作技巧高超的作家。

examples.en: The girl had grown more skillful with the sewing-machine.
examples.zh: 那女孩已能更熟練地使用縫紉機了。

examples.en: I was caught in a shower and soaked to the skin.
examples.zh: 我趕上一場陣雨，渾身濕透了。

examples.en: She suddenly started to feel very sleepy.
examples.zh: 她突然感到非常困倦。

words.gloss: v. 滑行；滑動 / n. 滑動；溜滑梯（slide-slid-slid）

examples.en: The boys amused themselves by sliding down the banister.
examples.zh: 男孩們從樓梯扶手滑下以取樂。

examples.en: The car went into a slide on the iced road.
examples.zh: 汽車在結冰的路上打滑了。

examples.en: He stepped on a banana peel and slipped on the floor.
examples.zh: 他踩到香蕉皮滑倒在地。

examples.en: Slippers are usually worn indoors.
examples.zh: 拖鞋通常是在室內穿的。

examples.en: Did you have a smooth flight from Los Angeles?
examples.zh: 從洛杉磯飛來一路還順利嗎？

examples.en: Let's drop in this café for a snack.
examples.zh: 咱們到這咖啡館吃點點心吧。

examples.en: That janitor is a snail who never gets things done.
examples.zh: 那個房屋管理員動作慢吞吞的，什麼事也做不成。

examples.en: He came to see me one snowy night.
examples.zh: 他在一個下著雪的夜晚來看我。

examples.en: I bought a bar of soap yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我買了一塊肥皂。

examples.en: My son is the best soccer player in the school.
examples.zh: 我兒子是全校最好的足球選手。

examples.en: George stayed out of the social life of the school.
examples.zh: 喬治置身於該校社交生活之外。

examples.en: Indifference will pose a threat to society.
examples.zh: 冷漠會對社會構成威脅。

examples.en: He was five feet in his socks.
examples.zh: 他不穿鞋身高為五英尺。

examples.en: Two whiskies and sodas, please.
examples.zh: 請來兩杯威士忌蘇打。

examples.en: Silk feels soft and smooth.
examples.zh: 絲織品摸起來柔軟光滑。

examples.en: Some soils are not suitable for farming.
examples.zh: 有些土壤不適於耕作。

examples.en: It may take a long time to find a solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 也許要花很長時間才能找到解決這問題的辦法。

examples.en: She tried to solve a crossword puzzle.
examples.zh: 她試著解答一道縱橫字謎。

examples.en: I was somewhat surprised to hear the news.
examples.zh: 聽到這消息我有些意外。

examples.en: That's just the sort of thing I want.
examples.zh: 那正是我所需要的那種東西。

examples.en: Christians believe that the soul lives forever.
examples.zh: 基督徒相信靈魂永生。

examples.en: These oranges taste sour.
examples.zh: 這些橘子吃起來很酸。

examples.en: She lives in southern Italy.
examples.zh: 她住在義大利南部。

examples.en: Do you know the source of Amazon River?
examples.zh: 你知道亞馬遜河的源頭嗎？

examples.en: Tofu is made from soybean.
examples.zh: 豆腐由大豆所製成。

examples.en: The chairman introduced the speaker to the audience.
examples.zh: 主席將演講人介紹給聽眾。

examples.en: Animals lack speech.
examples.zh: 動物不會說話。

words.gloss: n. 速度 / v. 疾馳超速

examples.en: You work with amazing speed.
examples.zh: 你工作起來速度奇快。

examples.en: The ambulance sped down the street.
examples.zh: 救護車飛快地通過街道。

examples.en: Her spelling has improved.
examples.zh: 她的拼寫進步了。

examples.en: Have you ever seen a spider spin its web?
examples.zh: 你看到過蜘蛛織網嗎？

examples.en: The spirit of a law is more important than its words.
examples.zh: 法律的精神比它的具體條文更重要。

examples.en: She was born with a silver spoon in her mouth, and everything has been done for her.
examples.zh: 她出生於富貴人家，什麼事都已為她安排得好好的。

examples.en: I think football is an exciting sport.
examples.zh: 我認為足球是一種刺激的運動。

words.gloss: n. 斑點；污點；地點 / v. 看到（spot-spotted-spotted）

examples.en: The boy's white shirt was marked up with spots of ink.
examples.zh: 那男孩的白襯衫上有墨水漬。

examples.en: This is the spot where the two trucks collided.
examples.zh: 這兒就是兩輛卡車相撞的地點。

examples.en: He spotted me immediately.
examples.zh: 他立刻看到我。

examples.en: I spread my arms as far apart as I could.
examples.zh: 我盡可能地將雙臂伸展開。

examples.en: Some girls are dancing on stage.
examples.zh: 一些女孩在舞臺上跳舞。

examples.en: My son is a stamp collector.
examples.zh: 我兒子是集郵愛好者。

examples.en: Your recent work has been below standard.
examples.zh: 你最近的工作一直低於標準。

examples.en: The vice president is in a state of poor health.
examples.zh: 副總統健康狀況不佳。

examples.en: We had beef steak for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃牛排。

examples.en: Tools of this kind are made from steel.
examples.zh: 這類工具是鋼製的。

examples.en: She took a few steps towards the window.
examples.zh: 她向窗口走了幾步。

words.gloss: v. 黏貼；刺 / n. 棍棒（stick-stuck-stuck）

examples.en: He stuck a stamp on an envelope.
examples.zh: 他把郵票貼在信封上。

examples.en: Eating too much or too rapidly will give you a stomachache.
examples.zh: 吃太多或吃太急都會讓你肚子痛。

examples.en: The boy threw some stones into the pond.
examples.zh: 男孩把幾塊石頭丟進池裡去。

words.gloss: n. 暴風雨；風波 / v. 下暴風雨

examples.en: It stormed all day yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天整日刮風下雨。

examples.en: I feel strange in the presence of strangers.
examples.zh: 在陌生人面前，我感到不自在。

examples.en: Strawberries are now out of season.
examples.zh: 現在不是草莓當令的時節。

examples.en: People kept coming in streams.
examples.zh: 人們川流不息地到來。

words.gloss: n. 緊張；壓力 / v. 強調；著重

examples.en: I was completely weighed down by the stress of examinations.
examples.zh: 我被考試的壓力壓垮了。

examples.en: The English teacher stressed the importance of reading aloud.
examples.zh: 英語老師強調了朗讀的重要性。

examples.en: She stretched out her hand for the dictionary.
examples.zh: 她伸手拿字典。

examples.en: He is very strict with his students.
examples.zh: 他對學生非常嚴格。

words.gloss: v. 襲擊 / n. 罷工（strike-struck-struck）

examples.en: He was struck by lightning.
examples.zh: 他被閃電擊中。

examples.en: They struggled for peace.
examples.zh: 他們為和平而戰。

examples.en: I really like the style of her clothes. She always looks gorgeous.
examples.zh: 我很喜歡她的衣服的款式。她總是看起來很美。

words.gloss: n. 地下鐵；地下鐵火車

examples.en: The new subway is being laid.
examples.zh: 新地鐵正在鋪設。

examples.en: He succeeded in landing the job.
examples.zh: 他謀得了那份工作。

examples.en: The millionaire's eldest son will succeed to his estate.
examples.zh: 這位富翁的長子將繼承他的產業。

examples.en: She was a success as an actress.
examples.zh: 她是位成功的女演員。

examples.en: Such accidents should not happen again.
examples.zh: 不可以再發生這種事故了。

examples.en: His rise to power was very sudden.
examples.zh: 他的掌權很令人意外。

examples.en: I suggested doing it a different way.
examples.zh: 我建議換個方式做。

examples.en: Her doctor suggested that she (should) take exercise every day.
examples.zh: 醫師建議她每天運動。

words.gloss: n. 套裝；訴訟 / v. 適合

examples.en: I picked out a black suit.
examples.zh: 我挑了一套黑色西裝。

examples.en: She has filed a suit against the college for sex discrimination.
examples.zh: 她對那所大學提出性別歧視的訴訟。

examples.en: The arrangement suited us both.
examples.zh: 這安排對我們兩人都合適。

examples.en: Many people applied for the job, but none was suitable.
examples.zh: 許多人來申請工作，但沒有一個合適的。

examples.en: The region is highly vulnerable to super typhoons.
examples.zh: 這個地區極易受超級颱風侵襲。

examples.en: Hope is a good breakfast, but it is a bad supper.
examples.zh: 希望，是美好的早餐，卻是一頓糟糕的晚餐。

words.gloss: n. 補給 / v. 供給

examples.en: We supply power to the three nearby towns.
examples.zh: 我們對附近的三個城鎮提供電力。

words.gloss: v. 支持 / n. 援助

examples.en: They supported the Democratic Party.
examples.zh: 他們支持民主黨。

examples.en: If the waves are big enough, we'll go surfing.
examples.zh: 如果浪夠大的話，我們就去衝浪。

examples.en: Many teenagers spend hours a day surfing the Net.
examples.zh: 很多青少年每天花數個小時上網。

words.gloss: v. 認為 / conj. 假如

examples.en: Do you suppose we'll win?
examples.zh: 你認為我們會贏嗎？

examples.en: We are supposed to check out of the hotel by 11 o'clock.
examples.zh: 我們應該在 11 點以前退房。

examples.en: Suppose you won the lottery, what would you do with the money?
examples.zh: 假設你中了樂透，你會怎麼用這筆錢？

examples.en: It has a rough surface.
examples.zh: 它表面粗糙。

words.gloss: v. 在…之後倖存；從…中逃生

examples.en: Only two passengers survived the air-crash.
examples.zh: 這次飛機失事只有兩名乘客倖免於死。

words.gloss: n. 燕子 / v. 吞嚥

examples.en: One swallow does not make a summer.
examples.zh: 一燕不成夏。

examples.en: She wore a sweater and jeans.
examples.zh: 她穿著毛衣及牛仔褲。

examples.en: He sweeps the room every day.
examples.zh: 他每天打掃房間。

examples.en: We saw dolphins swimming near our ship.
examples.zh: 我們看到海豚在我們船附近游泳。

examples.en: A bikini is a women's two-piece swimsuit, allowing women to show off their curvy figures.
examples.zh: 比基尼是兩件式的泳裝款式，能展現女性曼妙的身材。

examples.en: The lamp swung in the breeze.
examples.zh: 燈在微風中搖盪。

words.gloss: n. 開關 / v. 更換；改變

examples.en: Where is the light switch?
examples.zh: 電燈開關在那裡？

examples.en: Can we switch seats?
examples.zh: 我們可以換座位嗎？

words.gloss: n. 象徵；標誌；記號；符號

examples.en: The white bird is a symbol of freedom.
examples.zh: 白鳥是自由的象徵。

examples.en: X is the symbol for an unknown quantity.
examples.zh: x 表示未知數。

examples.en: We're having problems with our phone system.
examples.zh: 我們的電話系統有問題。

examples.en: Grandpa told the kids the tales of his childhood.
examples.zh: 爺爺給孩子們講他童年的故事。

examples.en: He missed the target.
examples.zh: 他未擊中靶子。

examples.en: The task has been fulfilled.
examples.zh: 任務已完成了。

examples.en: Half of my salary goes in tax.
examples.zh: 我的薪水有一半拿來繳稅。

examples.en: Husbands and wives may be taxed independently.
examples.zh: 夫妻可分別報稅。

examples.en: Warming up the teapot beforehand will allow you to get a stronger brew for your tea.
examples.zh: 泡茶之前先溫壺可以醞釀出更濃郁甘醇的茶湯。

examples.en: He was moved to tears.
examples.zh: 他感動得流下眼淚。

examples.en: He has torn a hole in his shirt.
examples.zh: 他的襯衫扯破了一個洞。

examples.en: Many people call the age we live in the age of technology.
examples.zh: 許多人把我們生活的時代叫做科技時代。

words.gloss: adj. 十幾歲的(13-19 歲) / n. 青少年

examples.en: He used to play the violin in his early teens.
examples.zh: 他青少年初期曾經拉過小提琴。

examples.en: The temperature dropped abruptly.
examples.zh: 氣溫驟然下降。

examples.en: They were sentenced to long terms in prison.
examples.zh: 他們被判處長期徒刑。

examples.en: 9/11 terrorist attacks triggered an enormous U.S. effort to combat terrorism.
examples.zh: 911 恐怖攻擊促使美國積極啟動反恐，打擊恐怖主義。

examples.en: The terrorist was wearing an explosive suicide vest during his attack.
examples.zh: 這個恐怖份子在攻擊中身穿自殺炸彈背心。

words.gloss: n. 正文 / v. 發簡訊

examples.en: The text of every chapter is followed by questions.
examples.zh: 每一章正文之後有問答題。

examples.en: Text me as soon as you get your exam results.
examples.zh: 一收到成績就發簡訊給我。

examples.en: He was reading a math textbook in the library.
examples.zh: 他在圖書館看一本數學教科書。

examples.en: He was down with the flu, and therefore couldn't attend the party.
examples.zh: 他患了流行性感冒，因此未能前來參加宴會。

examples.en: The thief was caught in the act.
examples.zh: 小偷當場被捕。

examples.en: The empress was thirsty for power.
examples.zh: 皇后渴望權力。

examples.en: After serious thought, he decided to accept their terms.
examples.zh: 經認真考慮，他決定接受他們的條件。

examples.en: This feeling persisted throughout the day.
examples.zh: 這種感覺持續了一整天。

examples.en: After the lightning came the thunder.
examples.zh: 閃電後接著是雷聲。

examples.en: They told her to water the flowers every day, and she did it thus.
examples.zh: 他們吩咐她每天澆花，於是她照辦了。

examples.en: To prevent the virus from spreading, sick children must stay home till they're well enough.
examples.zh: 為了預防病毒擴散，生病孩童要在家休養至康復為止。

examples.en: Traditionally, Chinese stay up till midnight on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 傳統上中國人除夕夜會守歲到半夜。

examples.en: Fleas are tiny insects.
examples.zh: 跳蚤是很小的昆蟲。

examples.en: Tires are usually made of rubber.
examples.zh: 輪胎通常由橡膠製成。

examples.en: She handed me a tissue just as I sneezed.
examples.zh: 我一打噴嚏她就遞給我衛生紙。

examples.en: The tissue samples are too thick for their cells to be examined under the microscope.
examples.zh: 這些組織樣本太厚，它們的細胞無法在顯微鏡下被檢視。

examples.en: The title of the novel is Sons and Lovers.
examples.zh: 這本小說的書名為《兒子和情人》。

words.gloss: v. 烤土司 / n. 土司；乾杯

examples.en: She toasted bread for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她烤麵包當早餐。

examples.en: Tofu is a healthy food.
examples.zh: 豆腐是健康食品。

examples.en: The teacher is speaking in a high tone.
examples.zh: 教師正在大聲說話。

examples.en: The doctor told the boy to put out his tongue.
examples.zh: 醫生告訴男孩把舌頭伸出來。

examples.en: I have a terrible toothache because there is a cavity in one of my teeth.
examples.zh: 因為蛀牙，我的牙痛得很厲害。

examples.en: Electric toothbrushes clean teeth and gums much better than manual toothbrushes.
examples.zh: 電動牙刷比手動牙刷更能把牙齒牙齦清洗乾淨。

examples.en: Mr. Adams made a tour around East Asia last year.
examples.zh: 亞當斯先生去年往東亞旅行了一次。

examples.en: They drove toward the beach.
examples.zh: 他們駕車朝海灘開去。

examples.en: We followed his tracks in the snow to a hut.
examples.zh: 我們沿著他在雪地上留下的足跡走到一間小屋旁。

words.gloss: n. 貿易 / v. 交易

examples.en: Fair trade is a social movement whose goal is to help producers in developing countries achieve better trading conditions and to promote sustainable farming.
examples.zh: 「公平交易」是一項社會運動，其目的在提供開發中國家生產者良好的貿易條件，並促進永續農業。

examples.en: My parents did their best to keep up the family tradition.
examples.zh: 我的父母為了保持家庭的傳統竭盡全力。

examples.en: Women are questioning their traditional role in society, as wives and mothers.
examples.zh: 婦女正質疑她們在社會中扮演的妻子和母親的傳統角色。

examples.en: The hunter set traps to catch foxes.
examples.zh: 獵人設陷阱捕捉狐狸。

examples.en: Please take the bag of trash to the garbage can.
examples.zh: 請將這袋垃圾拿到垃圾筒去。

words.gloss: v. 旅行 / n. 遊歷

examples.en: My uncle is traveling in south America.
examples.zh: 我叔父在南美洲旅行。

examples.en: It is said that the pirates buried their treasure on this island.
examples.zh: 據說海盜把他們的金銀財寶埋藏在這個島上。

examples.en: The trials show that smoking will do harm to people.
examples.zh: 試驗顯示抽煙對人體有害。

examples.en: He maintained his dignity throughout the trial.
examples.zh: 在整個審判過程中，他始終不失尊嚴。

examples.en: The three sides of a regular triangle are equal in length.
examples.zh: 正三角形的三條邊長度相同。

examples.en: He got into the castle by a trick.
examples.zh: 他耍了個花招混進了城堡。

examples.en: Is it true they're getting married?
examples.zh: 他們真要結婚了嗎？

words.gloss: n. 相信 / v. 委託

examples.en: I have no trust in him.
examples.zh: 我不信任他。

examples.en: Neither witness told the truth.
examples.zh: 兩個見證人都沒有講實話。

words.gloss: n. 管；筒；(英)地下鐵；(美)電視

examples.en: He slipped the telescope into a steel tube.
examples.zh: 他將望遠鏡收進一根鋼管內。

examples.en: Turtles are always considered slow.
examples.zh: 烏龜總是被認為慢吞吞的。

examples.en: A typhoon in 1954 sank a ferry, drowning 1,218 people.
examples.zh: 1954 年的一次颱風颳沉了一艘渡輪，淹死 1218 人。

words.gloss: adj. 有代表性的；獨特的

examples.en: This painting is typical of his early work.
examples.zh: 這幅畫是他早期的代表作。

examples.en: The ugly duckling turned into a graceful swan.
examples.zh: 醜小鴨變成優雅的天鵝。

examples.en: She sat under a striped umbrella.
examples.zh: 她坐在一把條紋遮陽傘下。

examples.en: The hour is a unit of time.
examples.zh: 小時是時間單位。

examples.en: At that time people believed the earth was the center of the universe.
examples.zh: 當時人們相信地球是宇宙的中心。

examples.en: This university is composed of five colleges and one graduate school.
examples.zh: 這所大學由五個學院和一個研究所組成。

examples.en: Take great care when you upload personal information.
examples.zh: 上傳個人資料時要格外小心。

examples.en: He laid a hand upon my shoulder.
examples.zh: 他把一隻手放在我肩上。

examples.en: Winter is almost upon us.
examples.zh: 冬天將至。

examples.en: He has a scar on his upper lip.
examples.zh: 他的上唇有一道疤痕。

words.gloss: v. 弄翻；推翻；使…生氣 / adj. 苦惱的

examples.en: The generals plotted to upset the government.
examples.zh: 將領們策劃推翻政府。

examples.en: Don't do anything that would upset him.
examples.zh: 不要做會讓他生氣的事。

examples.en: He's upset about his test scores.
examples.zh: 考試的分數讓他很苦惱。

examples.en: Henry lived upstairs.
examples.zh: 亨利住在樓上。

examples.en: I am used to walking to school.
examples.zh: 我習慣走路上學。

examples.en: Electric vehicle users have trouble finding a charging station.
examples.zh: 電動車輛使用者不易找到充電站。

examples.en: He came home later than usual.
examples.zh: 他回家比平時遲。

examples.en: I gained five kilograms during summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我在暑假增胖了五公斤。

examples.en: The road gradually widened until we found ourselves in a large valley.
examples.zh: 路漸漸寬了起來，最後我們走進了一個大的山谷。

words.gloss: adj. 值錢的；有用的 / n. 貴重物品(複數)

examples.en: He bought me a valuable diamond ring as a birthday present.
examples.zh: 他給我買了一只貴重的鑽戒作為生日禮物。

examples.en: He stores his valuables in the safe.
examples.zh: 他把貴重物品存放在保險櫃裡。

words.gloss: v. 重視 / n. 重要性；價格/價值

examples.en: This dictionary is of little value to you.
examples.zh: 這本詞典對你沒有什麼幫助。

examples.en: The basketball team had a string of victories last season.
examples.zh: 這個籃球隊在上一個賽季中贏得了一連串的勝利。

examples.en: These people were viewed as their most dangerous rivals.
examples.zh: 這些人被視為他們最危險的對手。

examples.en: They lived in a remote mountain village.
examples.zh: 他們住在一個偏僻的山村。

words.gloss: n. 投票 / v. 表決

examples.en: The matter will be decided by vote.
examples.zh: 此事將投票表決。

examples.en: She tied an apron around her waist.
examples.zh: 她將圍裙繫在腰間。

words.gloss: n. 男侍者 / 女侍者

examples.en: The waiter came to take their order.
examples.zh: 男侍來請他們點菜。

examples.en: He opened his wallet.
examples.zh: 他打開錢包。

examples.en: The mayor is confident the war against crime will be won.
examples.zh: 市長確信反犯罪活動之戰爭必定勝利。

examples.en: She washed her face and hands, then going downstairs.
examples.zh: 她洗了臉和手之後走下樓去。

examples.en: Don't waste your time and energy on trifles.
examples.zh: 別把你的時間和精力浪費在瑣事上。

examples.en: Many people like to eat watermelon in summer.
examples.zh: 許多人喜歡在夏天吃西瓜。

examples.en: It was a period of wealth and prosperity.
examples.zh: 那是一個富有和繁榮的時期。

examples.en: The wedding will take place in October.
examples.zh: 婚禮將於十月舉行。

examples.en: The office is open from 9:00 to 5:00 on weekdays.
examples.zh: 辦公室在工作日從九點到五點辦公。

examples.en: He weighed the parcel by hand.
examples.zh: 他用手掂一掂那一包包裹的重量。

examples.en: What is your weight?
examples.zh: 你體重多少？

words.gloss: adj. 西方的 / n. 西部片/小說(常大寫)

examples.en: I like movies, but I don't like Westerns.
examples.zh: 我喜歡電影，但不喜歡西部牛仔片。

examples.en: The blue whale is the world's largest living animal.
examples.zh: 藍鯨是世界上最大的動物。

examples.en: You must do whatever is best for you.
examples.zh: 什麼對你最有利你就得做什麼。

examples.en: Let me take the wheel.
examples.zh: 我來開車。

examples.en: Robbie had arranged for this man to come whenever needed.
examples.zh: 羅比作了安排讓這個人需要時就來。

words.gloss: conj. 無論何處 / adv. 任何地方

examples.en: Wherever one goes, there's always a spy hanging around.
examples.zh: 不管你走到哪裡，總有密探跟著。

examples.en: I'd like to go to Paris, Milan, or wherever.
examples.zh: 我想去巴黎、米蘭，或是別的什麼地方。

words.gloss: n. 耳語 / v. 小聲說話

examples.en: My colleagues heard a whisper that some of our branches would be closed.
examples.zh: 我的同事聽到耳語說我們的一些分店將會關閉。

examples.en: James is whispering something to Steve.
examples.zh: 詹姆斯在跟史蒂夫竊竊私語。

examples.en: Whoever else goes hungry, he won't.
examples.zh: 不管別的什麼人挨餓，他不會。

examples.en: I'm deeply sorry about the whole business.
examples.zh: 對整個事情我深感遺憾。

examples.en: I know who you are and whom you represent.
examples.zh: 我知道你是誰，也知道誰派你來的。

examples.en: The width of the room is 20 feet.
examples.zh: 這房間寬二十呎。

examples.en: There are few schools in the wilds of that country.
examples.zh: 該國的偏僻地區極少有學校。

examples.en: They are willing to come.
examples.zh: 他們願意來。

examples.en: The winter was cold, wet, and windy.
examples.zh: 那冬天又冷、又潮，加上多風。

examples.en: May I help you to another glass of wine?
examples.zh: 讓我來給你再斟杯酒好嗎？

examples.en: He aimed his gun at the eagle spreading its wings.
examples.zh: 他的槍瞄準那隻展開翅膀的老鷹。

words.gloss: n. 電線；電報；鐵絲網 / v. 電匯

examples.en: His wire is busy just now.
examples.zh: 他的電話線此刻沒有空。

examples.en: I asked my father to wire me some money.
examples.zh: 我請父親匯錢給我。

examples.en: She is pure within.
examples.zh: 她內心純潔。

examples.en: Wolves kill sheep and sometimes even attack men.
examples.zh: 狼吃羊，有時候甚至襲擊人。

examples.en: There was a look of wonder in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他眼中露出驚奇的神色。

words.gloss: n. 木材；樹林(常用複數形)

examples.en: The pavilion is made of wood.
examples.zh: 這亭子是木造的。

examples.en: His performances have become wooden and dull.
examples.zh: 他的演出變得呆板乏味。

examples.en: The textbook is accompanied by a workbook.
examples.zh: 這課本附有一本習作簿。

examples.en: The early bird gets the worm.
examples.zh: 早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。

examples.en: He wormed his small body through the hedge.
examples.zh: 他蠕動他那瘦小的身體鑽過了樹籬。

examples.en: Nothing worries me.
examples.zh: 我沒有什麼可擔心的。

examples.en: To make matters worse, I left my keys in the house.
examples.zh: 更糟的是，我把鑰匙放在家裡了。

examples.en: Of all the boys I know, Jack is the worst.
examples.zh: 在我認識的小孩中，傑克最壞。

examples.en: Many people wear wool in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天許多人穿毛料衣服。

words.gloss: pron. 價值… / n. 價值

examples.en: The plain-looking pen is worth 5,000 dollars.
examples.zh: 這支看似平凡的鋼筆價值五千元。

examples.en: This research project is of great worth.
examples.zh: 這一研究項目很有價值。

words.gloss: n. 創傷 / v. 受傷；蜿蜒；纏繞；上發條(wind 的過去式、分詞)

examples.en: She only got a wound on the skin.
examples.zh: 她只受了皮肉傷。

examples.en: He was wounded on the head.
examples.zh: 他的頭受傷了。

examples.en: A path wound up the valley.
examples.zh: 一條路在山谷間蜿蜒而上。

examples.en: I spent my youth in the country.
examples.zh: 我在鄉間度過了青少年時代。

examples.en: The entire body of a zebra is marked with black and white stripes.
examples.zh: 斑馬的全身都有黑白條紋。
